name_zh: Apevon Science 学术认证会员
desc_zh: 面向科研的 AI 智能体。高校教师和硕博研究生完成学术认证后，体验礼进会员卡包，自己选时候用：教师是 Plus 一个月（2 万积分，同时 3 个研究任务、2 个 GPU 任务），研究生是基础版一个月（5500 积分，同时 2 个研究任务、1 个 GPU 任务）。卡包长期有效，已有会员要等到期再用。月度积分每 30 天发一次、共 3 次（教师每次 1000、研究生每次 500），要到学术权益页领取，入账后 365 天有效。认证后 90 天内开通、续费或升级最多 3 次八折，失败不计次。本科生目前不能认证。
desc_en: An AI agent designed for scientific research. After completing academic certification, university faculty and master's/PhD students can access the membership gift package and use it at their convenience: faculty receive one month of Plus membership (20,000 points, with 3 research tasks and 2 GPU tasks simultaneously), while graduate students receive one month of the Basic version (5,500 points, with 2 research tasks and 1 GPU task simultaneously). The membership package is valid long-term; existing members should wait until their current membership expires before using it. Monthly points are issued three times every 30 days (1,000 points per issuance for faculty, 500 points per issuance for graduate students) and must be claimed on the Academic Benefits page, where they remain valid for 365 days after crediting. Within 90 days of certification, you can activate, renew, or upgrade up to three times at a 20% discount; failed attempts do not count toward this limit. Undergraduate students are currently not eligible for certification.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，注册或登录。
2. 打开左下角「新手活动」，提交学术认证和材料。高校教师和硕博研究生是不同档，本科生目前没有。
3. 通过后先看会员卡包。已有会员要到期再用体验礼。月度积分到学术权益页点领取。付费套餐 90 天内最多三次八折。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to register or log in.
2. Open the "New User Activities" section in the bottom-left corner and submit your academic certification and supporting documents. University faculty and master's/PhD students are in different tiers; undergraduate students are not currently eligible.
3. After approval, review the membership gift package first. Existing members should wait until their current membership expires before using the gift. Monthly points must be claimed on the Academic Benefits page. Paid plans offer up to three 20% discounts within 90 days.
badges_zh: 免费 1 个月 | 含教师

desc_zh: 用学术邮箱、做非商业科研或教学，可申请 Research Plan：每月 50 额度、15 名成员、20 个项目、增强增强，以及 RF-DETR 研究许可（非商业）。申请时，该工作区里的数据会公开到 Roboflow Universe，不要放不能公开的数据。已在付费或试用付费套餐的人看不到申请按钮，要先取消试用。课堂需求可另找官方说明是师生项目。这是审核额度，不是无上限算力。
desc_en: If you're using an academic email address for non-commercial research or educational purposes, you can apply for the Research Plan: 50 quota per month, 15 members, 20 projects, enhanced features, and an RF-DETR research license (non-commercial). When you apply, the data in this workspace will be made public on Roboflow Universe, so do not include any data that cannot be shared publicly. Users already on a paid plan or a paid trial will not see the application button; you must first cancel your trial. For classroom needs, you can contact official support separately and specify that it is a teacher-student project. This is a reviewed quota, not unlimited computing power.
claim_zh:
1. 用学术邮箱登录一个工作区。不要把不能公开的数据放进去。
2. 打开设置里的 Plan & Billing，拉到「Using Roboflow for research or education?」，点 Request Access。看不到按钮就先取消付费试用，再点击本页的「前往官网领取」看说明。
3. 选科研计划并确认升级。课堂定制需求按页面说明联系官方，并写明师生项目。
claim_en:
1. Log in to a workspace using an academic email address. Do not include any data that cannot be shared publicly.
2. Open Plan & Billing in the settings, scroll down to "Using Roboflow for research or education?", and click Request Access. If you don't see the button, first cancel your paid trial, then click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page to view the instructions.
3. Select the research plan and confirm the upgrade. For customized classroom needs, contact official support as described on the page and specify that it is a teacher-student project.
badges_zh: 每月 50 积分 | 含教师

desc_zh: 学生、教师和高校科研人员可以一直免费使用 W&B，用来记录实验、对比模型、做报告和团队协作，对接 PyTorch、Keras、JAX、Hugging Face 等。页面写明 Always free，不是限时券。课堂和实验室有入门材料，也有免费课程。学校若要办活动，可以在页面联系。论文里用了 W&B 的，官方希望引用并邮件告知。
desc_en: Students, teachers, and university researchers can use W&B for free indefinitely to log experiments, compare models, create reports, and collaborate with teams, with integration for PyTorch, Keras, JAX, Hugging Face, and more. The page states it's 'Always free,' not a time-limited offer. Introductory materials and free courses are available for classrooms and labs. Schools wishing to host events can contact the page. If you use W&B in your papers, the official team would appreciate a citation and an email notification.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校身份点击本页的「前往官网领取」注册。学术免费按官网对学生、教师和高校科研人员开放。
2. 在训练脚本里接入实验记录。课堂或实验室可先看页面上的免费教程和课程。
claim_en:
1. Use your university affiliation to click 'Go to Official Website to Claim' on this page and register. The academic free plan is available to students, teachers, and university researchers as outlined on the official website.
2. Integrate experiment logging into your training scripts. For classrooms or labs, you can first review the free tutorials and courses on the page.

desc_zh: 已验证的非营利组织购买 Microsoft 365 Copilot 可少 15%，年付为 25.50 美元/人/月。必须另外已有符合条件的 Microsoft 365 许可证。订阅里包含的 Copilot Chat 不另收费。美国页面还写 Business Premium 员工价为年付 5.50 美元/人/月，约为商业价的 25%。
desc_en: Verified nonprofits can save 15% on Microsoft 365 Copilot, at $25.50 per user per month when paid annually. An eligible Microsoft 365 license must already be in place. Copilot Chat included in the subscription is free. The US page also states that the Business Premium employee price is $5.50 per user per month when paid annually, which is about 25% of the commercial price.
claim_zh:
1. 先确认组织已通过微软非营利验证，并且已有 Microsoft 365 许可证。
2. 管理员点击本页的「前往官网领取」，在管理中心按非营利价格购买 Copilot。
3. 付款前核对人数和年付总价。Copilot Chat 已包含在 Microsoft 365 里，不必为聊天单独买 Copilot。
claim_en:
1. First, confirm that your organization has passed Microsoft's nonprofit verification and already has a Microsoft 365 license.
2. Administrators should click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and purchase Copilot at the nonprofit price in the admin center.
3. Before payment, verify the number of users and the total annual cost. Copilot Chat is already included in Microsoft 365, so there's no need to purchase Copilot separately for chat.

desc_zh: 认证高校的本科生和研究生，用 .edu 邮箱申请后可以领取免费语音额度，用来做课件配音、课程项目和黑客松。只限教育和非商业用途。支持约 83 种语言，也可以用大约 10 秒录音做声音克隆。额度数量以审核结果为准。
desc_en: Undergraduate and graduate students at accredited universities can apply using a .edu email address to receive a free voice quota for creating course audio, project work, and hackathons. Limited to educational and non-commercial use only. Supports approximately 83 languages, and you can also use a roughly 10-second recording for voice cloning. The quota amount is subject to approval results.
claim_zh:
1. 用.edu 邮箱点击本页的「前往官网领取」申请学生额度。
2. 等审核。通过后再用于课程、演示或比赛，不要拿去商用。
claim_en:
1. Use a .edu email address to click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to apply for the student quota.
2. Wait for approval. Use it for courses, presentations, or competitions after approval—do not use it for commercial purposes.

desc_zh: 学生和教师用学校或教育机构邮箱验证后，可以按教育价订阅 Mistral Pro。个人邮箱不行，学生证和在读证明也不能代替机构邮箱。折扣幅度以结算页为准。
desc_en: Students and teachers can subscribe to Mistral Pro at the education rate after verifying their school or educational institution email address. Personal email addresses are not eligible, and student IDs or proof of enrollment cannot replace an institutional email. The discount amount is subject to the checkout page.
claim_zh:
1. 准备学校或教育机构发的邮箱。Gmail、iCloud、Outlook 这类个人邮箱不能用。
2. 新账号直接用这个邮箱注册。已有账号的，先把账号邮箱改成机构邮箱。
3. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，按教育方案订阅 Pro。
4. 邮箱域名认不出来时，把域名发给 Mistral 客服。学校不发邮箱的，不能申请。
claim_en:
1. Prepare an email address issued by your school or educational institution. Personal email services like Gmail, iCloud, and Outlook are not acceptable.
2. Use this institutional email to register a new account. If you already have an account, first change the account email to your institutional email.
3. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and subscribe to Pro under the education plan.
4. If the email domain cannot be recognized, send the domain to Mistral customer support. If your school does not provide an institutional email, you are not eligible to apply.

desc_zh: 在读期间免费使用 Camber Student：每月 40 CPU 小时、5 GPU 小时、50 GB 存储和 50 条 Agent 消息。可连接 Postgres、Trino、S3，用自己的数据和代码做 AI Agent，也能从 Cursor 或 Claude Code 经 MCP 运行。
desc_en: Free access to Camber Student during your studies: 40 CPU hours, 5 GPU hours, 50 GB of storage, and 50 Agent messages per month. Connect to Postgres, Trino, and S3 to build AI Agents with your own data and code, or run them via MCP from Cursor or Claude Code.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生认证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 注册。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at GitHub Education.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and register using your GitHub account.

name_zh: WorkBuddy 教育公益版 教师每月 2000 积分
name_en: WorkBuddy Education Public Welfare Edition: 2000 Points per Month for Teachers
desc_zh: 腾讯 SSV 数字教育实验室和 WorkBuddy 团队面向全国在职教师的 AI 教学助理，不限地区和学段。审核通过后每人每月 2000 积分，每月 1 日自动补满，文章写明可连续领取 12 个月；账号本身长期有效。积分用完后仍可使用免费模型。2026 年 10 月至 12 月为试点期，2000 积分所有模型通用；试点期结束后，混元 4 单独 1600 积分，其他模型 400 积分，混元 3 暂时不限量。这套积分和个人版不互通，数据也不会自动同步。
desc_en: The Tencent SSV Digital Education Lab and the WorkBuddy team are offering an AI teaching assistant to all working teachers across China, regardless of region or educational level. After approval, each teacher will receive 2000 points per month, automatically replenished on the 1st of each month. The article states that this benefit can be claimed continuously for 12 months, and the account itself remains valid long-term. Free models can still be used after the points are exhausted. The pilot period runs from October to December 2026, during which all models will be accessible with the 2000 points. After the pilot period, Hunyuan 4 will require 1600 points separately, while other models will cost 400 points. Hunyuan 3 will temporarily have no usage limit. This point system is not interchangeable with the personal edition, and data will not be automatically synchronized.
claim_zh:
1. 在职老师打开公告，点「阅读原文」填写申领表：doc.weixin.qq.com/forms/AJEAIQdfAAoAXcAJQZtABoCNHisaiAXTf。也可以在「腾讯SSV」公众号菜单选择「一起SSV」-「WB教育公益版」。
2. 填写教师身份信息。审核通过后 3 个工作日内开通。登录必须使用报名时登记的手机号，一个手机号对应一个教育公益版账号。
3. 电脑端打开 WorkBuddy 5.8 及以上版本，用手机号验证码登录，在账号列表中选择「教育公益版」。已经装过的升级即可；有区域培训通知时，按通知里的链接下载。
4. 小程序登录时选择「企业版」，再输入登记的手机号。如果当前登的是个人版，先退出再按这个方式登录。
5. 学校要批量开通，填写批量收集表后发到项目群，或发到 p_guibzhang@tencent.com。生成内容先人工核对再用于课堂。
claim_en:
1. Working teachers should open the announcement and click "Read Original" to fill out the application form: doc.weixin.qq.com/forms/AJEAIQdfAAoAXcAJQZtABoCNHisaiAXTf. Alternatively, select "Together SSV" > "WB Education Public Welfare Edition" from the menu of the official "Tencent SSV" WeChat account.
2. Fill in your teacher identification information. The account will be activated within 3 business days after approval. You must use the mobile number registered during sign-up to log in; each mobile number corresponds to one Education Public Welfare Edition account.
3. Open WorkBuddy version 5.8 or higher on your computer, log in with the verification code for your mobile number, and select "Education Public Welfare Edition" from the account list. If already installed, simply upgrade. When a regional training notice is issued, download the app via the link provided in the notice.
4. When logging in via the mini-program, select "Enterprise Edition" and then enter your registered mobile number. If you are currently logged into the personal edition, log out first and then follow this procedure to log in.
5. For schools wishing to activate accounts in bulk, fill out the bulk collection form and send it to the project group or to p_guibzhang@tencent.com. Content generated by the tool should be manually reviewed before use in the classroom.
badges_zh: 每月 2000 积分 | 含教师

name_zh: Google Antigravity 科研人员免费最高档
name_en: Google Antigravity Free Access to the Highest Tier for Researchers
desc_zh: 最多 1 万名入选的科研人员，可免费使用 Google Antigravity 最高用量档 6 个月，并使用 Gemini 4 Argon。面向在大学、可授学位的院校、非营利研究机构或国家实验室从事非商业科研的人，包括教师、实验室负责人、博后、博士和硕士。每周滚动审核，只通知入选的人，提交申请不代表一定通过。额度加在提交表单时登录的那个 Google 账号上，走的是个人版，不是学校的 Gemini Enterprise。
desc_en: Up to 10,000 selected researchers will receive free access to the highest usage tier of Google Antigravity for 6 months, along with access to Gemini 4 Argon. This offer is for individuals engaged in non-commercial research at universities, degree-granting institutions, non-profit research organizations, or national laboratories, including faculty, lab directors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and master's students. Applications are reviewed on a rolling weekly basis, and only selected applicants will be notified. Submitting an application does not guarantee approval. The allocation will be added to the Google account used to log in when submitting the form, under the personal version of the service, not the school's Gemini Enterprise account.
claim_zh:
1. 用打算接收额度的 Google 账号登录。个人 Gmail 和学校的 Workspace 账号都可以。学校账号要先确认能登录 Antigravity。
2. 在科学用途页点「在此申请」。填写所在机构、机构邮箱，以及实验室或课题组的公开网页。
3. 至少提供一个有效的 ORCID，或一个有效的 Google Scholar 主页。两个都没有的申请不会被考虑。
4. 用 3 到 4 句话说明未来 6 到 12 个月要做的研究，至少 300 个字符。不要写保密或专有内容。
5. 入选后，最高档会加到提交时登录的账号上，为期 6 个月。没有入选不会收到通知。
claim_en:
1. Log in with the Google account you want to receive the allocation. Both personal Gmail accounts and institutional Workspace accounts are acceptable. If using an institutional account, confirm first that it has access to Antigravity.
2. On the scientific use page, click "Apply here." Provide your institution, institutional email address, and a public webpage for your lab or research group.
3. Include at least one valid ORCID or a valid Google Scholar profile. Applications without either will not be considered.
4. Describe your research plans for the next 6 to 12 months in 3 to 4 sentences, totaling at least 300 characters. Do not include confidential or proprietary information.
5. If selected, the highest tier will be added to the account used during submission for a period of 6 months. Unsuccessful applicants will not receive a notification.
badges_zh: 最高档 · 6 个月 | 含教师

name_zh: Rosalind Academic Plan 实验室免费席位
name_en: Rosalind Academic Plan Free Seats for Labs
desc_zh: 面向美国大学的学术实验室。由 PI 或实验室负责人申请，审核通过后最多 30 个 ChatGPT Business Standard 席位可免费使用 12 个月，并在可信访问批准后使用生命科学模型 GPT-Rosalind。工作区里也能用 ChatGPT 和 Codex，不含 API。研究数据默认不用于训练，但没有零数据保留。这和 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 不是同一个计划。
desc_en: For academic labs at U.S. universities. Applications are submitted by the PI or lab director. Upon approval, up to 30 ChatGPT Business Standard seats can be used free of charge for 12 months, and the life sciences model GPT-Rosalind can be used after trusted access is approved. ChatGPT and Codex are also available in the workspace, but the API is not included. Research data is not used for training by default, but there is no zero-data retention policy. This is not the same program as ChatGPT for Academic Researchers.
claim_zh:
1. 确认实验室在美国的大学，并且学校允许单独开通 ChatGPT Business 工作区。学校已经签了 OpenAI Enterprise 协议的，改为联系学校管理员，走 Enterprise 申请。
2. 由 PI 或实验室负责人用绑定学校.edu 邮箱的 ChatGPT 账号，在公告页提交学术实验室申请。填写学校、实验室、职务和预期用途，并完成身份核验。
3. 准备一位学校指定的生物安全联系人，例如环境健康与安全、研究安全或生物安全官员。
4. 批准后按邮件完成工作区设置。开通时需要绑定付款卡。再把使用同一学校邮箱域名的成员加进来，并单独打开他们的 GPT-Rosalind 权限。
5. 免费期最长 12 个月，一个工作区最多 30 席。实验室成员不能单独申请。到期后的价格以获批时的协议为准。
claim_en:
1. Confirm that the lab is at a U.S. university and that the institution allows separate activation of a ChatGPT Business workspace. If the institution has already signed an OpenAI Enterprise agreement, contact the school administrator instead and proceed with the Enterprise application process.
2. The PI or lab director must submit the academic lab application on the announcement page using a ChatGPT account linked to a school.edu email address. Provide the school, lab, role, and intended use, and complete identity verification.
3. Prepare a biosecurity contact designated by the school, such as an environmental health and safety officer, research safety officer, or biosecurity officer.
4. After approval, complete workspace setup via email. A payment card must be linked during activation. Then add members using the same school email domain and separately enable their GPT-Rosalind permissions.
5. The free period lasts up to 12 months, with a maximum of 30 seats per workspace. Lab members cannot apply individually. Pricing after the free period will follow the agreement in effect at the time of approval.
badges_zh: 最多 30 席 · 12 个月 | 含教师
badges_en: Up to 30 seats · 12 months | Teachers too

name_zh: OpenASI 吉大师生免费前沿模型算力
name_en: OpenASI: Free Cutting-Edge Model Computing Power for Jilin University Students and Faculty
desc_zh: OpenASI 是面向吉林大学师生的非营利开放平台，由吉大学生初创企业 BitMiracle AI Lab 全资赞助，免费提供限量的前沿模型算力。注册需要 @mails.jlu.edu.cn 或 @jlu.edu.cn 邮箱，以及邀请码。
desc_en: OpenASI is a non-profit open platform for students and faculty at Jilin University, fully sponsored by BitMiracle AI Lab, a startup founded by Jilin University students. It provides a limited amount of free computing power for cutting-edge models. Registration requires an email address from @mails.jlu.edu.cn or @jlu.edu.cn, as well as an invitation code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开注册页，用 @mails.jlu.edu.cn 或 @jlu.edu.cn 邮箱创建账号。
2. 填写邀请码。还没有邀请码时，加入 QQ 群 1007610343 获取。
3. 登录后在额度内使用前沿模型。名额和额度有限，以平台当时说明为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the registration page and create an account using an email from @mails.jlu.edu.cn or @jlu.edu.cn.
2. Enter your invitation code. If you don't have one yet, join the QQ group 1007610343 to obtain one.
3. After logging in, use the cutting-edge models within your allocated quota. The number of spots and available quota are limited, subject to the platform's current terms.

name_zh: Granola 学生免费 12 个月
name_en: Granola Free for Students for 12 Months
desc_zh: 美国、英国和加拿大认证高校的在读生（含博士）可申请 12 个月免费的 Granola Business，把课堂录音整理成可搜索的笔记。其他国家不在这次活动范围内。
desc_en: Currently enrolled students (including doctoral students) at accredited universities in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada can apply for 12 months of free Granola Business to transcribe classroom recordings into searchable notes. This promotion is not available in other countries.
claim_zh:
确认学校在美国、英国或加拿大。
打开页面申请 12 个月 Granola Business，并按要求验证在读身份。
claim_en:
Confirm that your school is located in the United States, United Kingdom, or Canada.
Open the page to apply for 12 months of Granola Business and verify your current student status as required.

desc_zh: 为学生用户提供丰富的 AI 工具，涵盖语音生成、智能笔记、设计开发等实用领域。
desc_en: Provide student users with a wealth of AI tools, covering practical fields such as voice generation, intelligent note-taking, and design and development.
claim_zh: ElevenLabs 发布的「AI Student Pack」为学生提供包括 ElevenLabs 语音AI、ElevenReader 智能朗读、Notion 笔记工具、Headspace 冥想减压、Superhuman 邮箱客户端等在内的16种 AI 工具的免费试用和大幅折扣，涵盖学习辅助、创作效率和心理健康等多个方面，帮助学生提升学习和生活效率。领取需注册官方账号，部分优惠限量，详情以官网为准。
claim_en: The AI Student Pack from ElevenLabs gives students free trials and significant discounts on 16 AI tools, including ElevenLabs voice AI, ElevenReader smart read-aloud, Notion note-taking, Headspace meditation and stress relief, and the Superhuman email client. It covers study assistance, creative efficiency, and mental health, among other areas, helping students improve their learning and daily-life efficiency. To claim it, you need to register an official account; some offers are limited, and details are subject to the official website.

desc_zh: 符合条件的学生可以免费使用 Gemini 的学生方案 12 个月。名额、国家和地区经常变，以学生页能不能验证为准，不是所有学校邮箱都能过。
desc_en: Eligible students can use Gemini's student plan for free for 12 months. Availability, quotas, and eligible countries/regions change frequently. Approval depends on whether you can complete verification on the student page; not all school email addresses will work.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用页面要求的 Google 账号登录。
2. 完成学生验证。通过后看账户里的 12 个月到期日，到期前取消才会避免续费。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and sign in with the Google account required by the page.
2. Complete student verification. Once approved, check the 12-month expiration date in your account. Cancel before the expiration date to avoid automatic renewal.

desc_zh: Dify 是搭建 AI 应用和智能体的平台。教育用户可以申请教育专业版，通过后免费使用一年。
desc_en: Dify is a platform for building AI applications and agents. Education users can apply for the Education Professional Edition and use it for free for one year upon approval.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱注册 Dify。
2. 按教育页提交申请，说明你是学生或教师。
3. 审核通过后开通一年教育专业版。到期前看页面是否还能续。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and register for Dify using your school email.
2. Submit an application on the education page, explaining that you are a student or teacher.
3. After approval, you will gain access to the Education Professional Edition for one year. Check the page before expiration to see if it can be renewed.
badges_zh: 免费 1 年 | 含教师

2. 按页面完成学生验证。通过后 Pro 免费一年，以账户里显示的到期日为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to register or log in to iAsk.
2. Complete the student verification on the page. Once approved, you'll receive one year of free Pro access, as indicated by the expiration date shown in your account.

desc_zh: Perplexity 是带引用来源的 AI 搜索。限时五折升级 Pro：年付约 $9/月，含深度研究、顶级模型切换、更高用量与记忆、文档/应用生成，以及扩展 Computer 权限。新订阅另送约 US$40 Computer 额度（4000 bonus credits）。原「学生一年免费」已不适用，请以升级页现价为准。
desc_en: Perplexity is an AI search engine with cited sources. Limited-time 50% off Pro: about $9/month when billed annually. Includes deep research, top AI model selection, higher usage and memory, document/app creation, and expanded Computer access. New upgrades also get about US$40 in Computer credits (4,000 bonus credits). The old one-year student free offer no longer applies; check the upgrade page for current pricing.
claim_zh: 1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」登录后进入 Upgrade / Select your plan。2. 限时五折：年付约 $9/月，包含深度研究、可选顶级模型、更高用量与记忆、文档和应用生成，以及扩展 Computer。3. 升级可见 +US$40 free Computer credits（4000 bonus credits，限时/新订阅福利，用完后 Pro 通常不再按月赠送额度）。4. 学生/教师若仍有 Education 通道，可在账号内走身份验证，最终价格以结算页为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, log in, then go to Upgrade / Select your plan.
2. Limited-time 50% off: annual billing is about $9/month and includes deep research, selectable top models, higher usage and memory, document and app generation, and expanded Computer.
3. Upon upgrading, you can see +US$40 free Computer credits (4000 bonus credits, a limited-time/new subscription benefit; after they are used up, Pro usually no longer grants monthly credits).
4. If students/teachers still have the Education channel, they can complete identity verification within their account; the final price is subject to the checkout page.

desc_zh: Manus 是 AI 助手。学生注册不需要邀请码，可以直接获得 1000 积分，用于对话和创作。
desc_en: Manus is an AI assistant. Students can register without an invitation code and receive 1000 credits directly for conversations and creation.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学生身份注册。
2. 注册完成后查看积分余额。1000 积分用完后的价格以 Manus 当前账单为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and register as a student.
2. Check your credit balance after registration. The price after the 1000 credits are used up will be based on Manus' current billing.

desc_zh: 使用.edu 邮箱验证即可免费获得 Free.ai Pro 权限，每月 50 万 Token，支持 400+ AI 工具、370+ 模型（含 GPT-4o、Claude、Gemini），无需信用卡，每 30 天重新验证续订。
desc_en: Verify your.edu email to get free Pro access to Free.ai — 500,000 tokens/month, 400+ AI tools, 370+ models including GPT-4o, Claude and Gemini. No credit card required. Re-verify every 30 days to continue.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」
2. 输入.edu 邮箱、姓名、院校及角色（学生/教师/研究员）
3. 点击「Verify & Get Free Pro Access」，邮箱收到验证链接后点击激活
4. 立即获得 Pro 权限：每月 50 万 Token + 400+ AI 工具 + 全量 API 访问
5. 每 30 天会收到续订验证邮件，点击确认即可继续使用

注意：需要有效的.edu 邮箱；非.edu 邮箱的国际学生可联系官方人工审核。
claim_en:
1. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Enter your.edu email, name, school, and role (student/teacher/researcher)
3. Click Verify & Get Free Pro Access; when the verification link arrives in your email, click it to activate
4. Get Pro access immediately: 500,000 tokens per month + 400+ AI tools + full API access
5. Every 30 days, you'll receive a renewal verification email; click confirm to continue using it

Note: A valid.edu email is required; international students without a.edu email can contact official support for manual review.

desc_zh: OpenAI 面向美国持牌临床医生提供专属医疗工作区，通过身份验证后可访问专为临床工作流程设计的安全 ChatGPT 环境。
desc_en: OpenAI offers a secure ChatGPT medical workspace built for clinical workflows. US licensed clinicians can verify their credentials to gain access.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」
2. 登录或注册 ChatGPT 账号
3. 按照页面指引完成美国临床医生身份验证
4. 验证成功后即可访问专为临床工作流程打造的安全 ChatGPT 医疗工作区

注意：仅限美国持牌临床医生申请。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Log in or sign up for a ChatGPT account
3. Follow the page instructions to complete U.S. clinician identity verification
4. Once verification succeeds, you can access the secure ChatGPT medical workspace built for clinical workflows

Note: Only U.S. licensed clinicians can apply.

name_zh: Claude Builder Club 教育账户
name_en: Claude Builder Club - Free Claude Pro / Education
desc_zh: Claude Builder Club 面向学生和教育者提供免费的 Claude Pro 或 Claude 教育版账户，助力学习和研究。

3. 提交申请，等待审核通知

claim_en:
1. Visit the application form: the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Fill in personal information and information about your educational institution
3. Submit the application and wait for review notification
4. After approval, you will receive a Claude Pro or education account

name_zh: ChatGPT Plus 退伍军人免费一年
name_en: ChatGPT Plus Free for One Year for Veterans
desc_zh: 面向美国军人：过去 12 个月内从现役退伍或退休的人，以及未来 12 个月内即将离开现役的军人。用 ID.me 验证后，可在个人 ChatGPT 账号上免费使用一年 ChatGPT Plus。Plus 包含 GPT-6：聊天里可用 GPT-6 Sol 的中档和高档思考，ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 里包含 GPT-6 Astra，另外还有更高的消息和上传额度、深度研究、图像生成、项目和自定义 GPT。每人限领一次，不能转赠，也不能和其他优惠叠加。企业工作区账号不能领。通过 App Store 或 Google Play 订阅的 Plus，要等移动端订阅结束后才能领。免费年结束后按原价续费，除非提前取消。
desc_en: For U.S. military personnel: Individuals who have been discharged from active duty or retired within the past 12 months, as well as those who will leave active duty within the next 12 months. After verification via ID.me, you can use ChatGPT Plus for free for one year on your personal ChatGPT account. Plus includes GPT-6: mid-tier and high-tier thinking capabilities with GPT-6 Sol in chat, GPT-6 Astra in ChatGPT Work and Codex, as well as higher message and upload limits, in-depth research, image generation, projects, and custom GPTs. This offer is limited to one claim per person, cannot be transferred, and cannot be combined with other promotions. Enterprise workspace accounts are not eligible. For Plus subscriptions purchased through the App Store or Google Play, you must wait until your mobile subscription ends before claiming the offer. After the free year ends, your subscription will renew at the regular price unless canceled in advance.
claim_zh:
1. 用要领取优惠的个人 ChatGPT 账号登录，打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 选择 Verify with ID.me，完成军人身份验证，并允许把结果发给 OpenAI。如果没有返回退役日期，就按提示补上。
3. 页面显示资格确认后，点 Claim offer。已经在网页版订阅 Plus 的不要先取消，验证后会直接记上一整年。
4. 如果 Plus 是在 App Store 或 Google Play 买的，先在对应商店取消，等订阅结束后再回来领取。
claim_en:
1. Log in with the personal ChatGPT account you want to use for the offer and open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Select Verify with ID.me, complete the military identity verification, and allow the results to be sent to OpenAI. If your discharge date is not returned, follow the prompts to provide it.
3. Once your eligibility is confirmed on the page, click Claim offer. If you are already subscribed to Plus via the web version, do not cancel first; your subscription will be extended by a full year after verification.
4. If your Plus subscription was purchased through the App Store or Google Play, cancel it first in the respective store, then return to claim the offer after your subscription has ended.

name_zh: ChatGPT 教师版 免费至 2028 年 6 月
name_en: ChatGPT for Educators: Free Until June 2028
desc_zh: 面向美国认证 K–12 学校或学区在职的教师、职员、校领导和学区管理员，学生不能申请。验证学校邮箱后，可以使用面向课堂的 ChatGPT 工作区，免费到 2028 年 6 月。帮助中心目前列出的能力包括 GPT-5.1（Instant、Auto、Reasoning-Mini）、文件上传、深度研究、语音、图像生成、自定义 GPT，以及 SSO、角色权限和分析。默认不把内容用于训练模型，并提供面向学校的隐私保护。一个工作区只能放同一个学区的人。
desc_en: Available to active teachers, staff, school leaders, and district administrators at U.S.-accredited K–12 schools or school districts. Students are not eligible. After verifying your school email, you can access the classroom-focused ChatGPT workspace for free until June 2028. The capabilities currently listed in the Help Center include GPT-5.1 (Instant, Auto, Reasoning-Mini), file uploads, deep research, voice, image generation, custom GPTs, as well as SSO, role-based permissions, and analytics. Content is not used for model training by default, and school-specific privacy protections are provided. Only individuals from the same school district can be added to a single workspace.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 [本页的](https://xn--8pvn55a0tz/)「前往官网领取」，用学校或学区邮箱开始验证。
2. 通过后选择新建本校或本学区的工作区，或加入域名下已有的工作区，并填写职务、学科和年级。
3. 管理员可以邀请同区已验证的同事，并配置 SSO 和权限。不能把其他学区的老师加进来。
4. 验证页报错时，换一个浏览器，用同一个 ChatGPT 账号重试。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and start verification using your school or district email.
2. After verification, choose to create a new workspace for your school or district, or join an existing workspace under your domain, and fill in your role, subject, and grade level.
3. Administrators can invite verified colleagues from the same district and configure SSO and permissions. Teachers from other districts cannot be added.
4. If you encounter an error on the verification page, try again using a different browser with the same ChatGPT account.

desc_zh: 硅基流动面向学生的新用户体验金，用来试用模型 API。金额和有效期以飞书文档里的当期活动为准。
desc_en: A new user trial credit from SiliconFlow for students, intended for testing the model API. The amount and validity period are subject to the current promotion details in the Feishu document.
