2. 用活动要求的方式注册。体验金是一次性的，用完或过期就不会再自动补充。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and read the current student promotion details.
2. Register using the method specified in the promotion. The trial credit is a one-time offer and will not be automatically replenished once used or expired.

name_zh: Google Colab Pro 教育一年
name_en: Google Colab Pro Education for One Year
desc_zh: 用教育邮箱可以免费使用 Colab Pro 一年，比免费版有更好的 GPU 和更长的运行时间。一年结束后不会自动再送，要以当时的教育活动为准。
desc_en: You can use Colab Pro for free for one year with an educational email account, which offers better GPUs and longer runtime compared to the free version. The free access will not be automatically renewed after the year ends; eligibility will depend on ongoing educational promotions at that time.
claim_zh:
1. 用教育邮箱对应的 Google 账号点击本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 按页面开通一年 Pro。看清楚到期日，到期后会回到免费版或要求付费。
claim_en:
1. Use the Google account associated with your educational email to click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page.
2. Follow the page instructions to activate the one-year Pro subscription. Pay attention to the expiration date, as your account will revert to the free version or require payment after it expires.

desc_zh: NoteGPT 用来总结 YouTube 等视频。学生可以免费使用一个月，之后是否收费以定价页为准。
desc_en: NoteGPT is used to summarize videos from YouTube and other platforms. Students can use it for free for one month. Whether it will be paid afterward is subject to the pricing page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，注册并找到学生或教育方案。
2. 完成验证后看账户里的到期日。一个月结束前如果不再使用，记得取消。
claim_en:
1. Click 「Go to Official Website to Claim」 on this page, register, and find the student or education plan.
2. After completing verification, check the expiration date in your account. If you no longer plan to use it before the month ends, remember to cancel.

desc_zh: Anthropic与Northeastern University、LSE和Champlain College等高校合作，为教育机构提供Claude AI服务
desc_en: Campus wide partnerships: Northeastern University, LSE and Champlain College providing Claude AI services for educational institutions
claim_zh: Anthropic Claude for Education为高等教育机构提供先进的AI助手服务。通过与知名大学的合作伙伴关系，学生和教职员工可以使用Claude进行学术研究、写作辅助、代码编程等教育相关任务。需要通过合作院校申请访问权限。
claim_en: Anthropic Claude for Education provides advanced AI assistant services for higher education institutions. Through partnerships with leading universities, students and faculty can use Claude for academic research, writing assistance, coding, and other education-related tasks. Access must be requested through a partner institution.

name_zh: 阿里云 QoderWork CN 高校专属权益
name_en: Alibaba Cloud QoderWork CN Student & Teacher Benefits
desc_zh: QoderWork CN 是阿里云推出的桌面级 AI 智能体助手，支持通过对话完成 PPT 编写美化、论文排版查重、数据分析与可视化、代码生成与调试等学习任务。高校专属权益面向在校大学生与教师：通过身份核验后，在享受新用户首月免费 Pro（价值 59 元）的基础上，可额外获得 4,000 Credits（有效期 90 天）。学生通过支付宝连接学信网学籍信息完成实时核验；教师提交身份证明后 1-3 个工作日审核，权益在审核通过后 T+1 工作日自动发放。同一身份仅可绑定 1 个阿里云账号、领取 1 次权益。
desc_en: QoderWork CN is Alibaba Cloud's desktop AI agent assistant for completing study tasks via conversation: PPT creation, paper editing, data analysis & visualization, and code generation. University students and teachers who pass identity verification receive a free first-month Pro membership (worth CNY 59) plus 4,000 additional Credits (valid 90 days). Students verify instantly via Alipay + Xuexin.com; teachers submit credentials for 1-3 business day review, with benefits issued T+1 day post-approval. Each identity may bind to only one Alibaba Cloud account and claim benefits once.
claim_zh:
步骤一：下载 QoderWork CN 客户端并使用阿里云账号登录，领取新用户首月免费 Pro 权益。
步骤二：返回认证页面本页的「前往官网领取」，使用同一阿里云账号登录。
步骤三（学生）：点击【学生认证 -> 立即领取】，按提示通过支付宝查询学信网学籍信息完成实时核验，核验成功后即可领取 4,000 Credits。
步骤三（教师）：点击【教师认证】，上传教师身份证明材料，等待 1-3 个工作日审核，审核通过后 T+1 工作日自动发放权益。
注意：同一身份只能绑定 1 个阿里云账号，仅可领取 1 次。近一个月内已完成认证的用户可直接领取，无需二次认证。
claim_en:
Step 1: Download the QoderWork CN client and log in with an Alibaba Cloud account to claim the new user first-month free Pro benefit.
Step 2: Return to the verification page the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and log in with the same Alibaba Cloud account.
Step 3 (Students): Click [Student Verification -> Claim Now], follow the prompts to query CHSI student status information via Alipay for real-time verification, and after successful verification, claim 4,000 Credits.
Step 3 (Teachers): Click [Teacher Verification], upload teacher identity proof materials, wait 1-3 working days for review, and benefits will be automatically issued on T+1 working day after approval.
Note: The same identity can only be bound to 1 Alibaba Cloud account and can only be claimed 1 time. Users who have completed verification within the past month can claim directly without a second verification.

name_zh: ChatGPT 学术研究人员计划
desc_zh: OpenAI 面向高校教职人员和博士后研究人员推出的专属计划，审核通过后可免费获得 12 个月的专属 ChatGPT 工作空间。每个工作空间最多支持 5 名成员（申请人及最多 4 名同机构协作者），享有 ChatGPT Pro 级别的使用配额、最新前沿模型访问权限，并配备企业级数据隐私保护（数据默认不用于训练模型）。申请时需通过 SheerID 验证机构隶属关系、提交代表性论文及研究用途说明。
desc_en: OpenAI's exclusive program for university faculty and postdoctoral researchers. Approved applicants receive 12 months of complimentary access to a dedicated ChatGPT workspace with ChatGPT Pro-level usage, the latest frontier models, and business-grade data privacy protections (data not used for training by default). Each workspace supports up to 5 members — the applicant plus up to 4 verified collaborators from the same institution. Applicants verify institutional affiliation via SheerID and submit a qualifying paper with a brief description of intended research use.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」查看最新申请入口与资格要求。
2. 使用学校/机构邮箱登录 OpenAI 账号。
3. 通过 SheerID 完成学术机构隶属关系验证。
4. 提交一篇符合条件的代表性论文及研究用途简短说明。
5. 审核通过后以 $0 完成结算（需绑定有效信用卡），即可创建专属研究工作空间。
6. 工作空间建好后，可邀请最多 4 名同机构成员加入。

注意：本计划仅面向教职人员和博士后研究人员，提供 ChatGPT 访问权限（非 API 额度）。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to view the latest application entry and eligibility requirements.
2. Sign in to your OpenAI account using your school/institution email.
3. Complete academic institution affiliation verification through SheerID.
4. Submit one eligible representative paper and a brief description of your research use.
5. After approval, complete checkout at $0 (a valid credit card is required) to create your dedicated research workspace.
6. Once the workspace is set up, you can invite up to 4 members from the same institution to join.

Note: This program is only for faculty and postdoctoral researchers and provides ChatGPT access (not API credits).

name_zh: ChatGPT Plus 学生免费订阅
desc_zh: OpenAI 面向在读大学生推出的 ChatGPT Plus 免费订阅活动。通过 SheerID 验证在校学生身份后，可免费获得数月 ChatGPT Plus 会员（具体时长视活动期次而定，当前活动免费 4 个月）。Plus 包含 GPT-6：聊天里可用 GPT-6 Sol，ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 里包含 GPT-6 Astra，另外还有扩展的深度研究、图像生成、项目、自定义 GPT，以及更高的消息和上传额度。活动仅限美国及加拿大在校大学生参与，需使用学校颁发的.edu 邮箱，免费期结束后将按月自动续费，可随时取消。
desc_en: OpenAI's free ChatGPT Plus subscription offer for current university students. After verifying your student status through SheerID, you get several months of ChatGPT Plus at no cost (the exact length depends on the campaign period; the current offer is 4 months free). Plus includes GPT-6: GPT-6 Sol in chat, GPT-6 Astra in ChatGPT Work and Codex, plus extended deep research, image generation, projects, custom GPTs and higher message and upload limits. The offer is limited to current university students in the United States and Canada and requires a school-issued.edu email. After the free period ends, the subscription renews automatically each month and can be canceled at any time.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」（如页面空白，请使用全局代理模式或无痕窗口重试）。
2. 点击「Get Offer」进入 SheerID 验证表单，填写学校名称、姓名、出生日期及学校颁发的.edu 邮箱（不可使用校友邮箱）。
3. SheerID 会通过学籍数据库自动核验，或要求登录学校 SSO，或要求上传在读证明文件（学生证/注册确认函，需包含姓名和当前学期信息）。
4. 验证通过后，ChatGPT 账号自动升级为 Plus，免费期届满前请在订阅设置中取消以避免扣款。

注意：仅限美国和加拿大在读大学生，每账号限领一次，不支持高中生。
claim_en:
1. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page (if the page is blank, try again with global proxy mode or an incognito window).
2. Click "Get Offer" to open the SheerID verification form and enter your school name, name, date of birth and school-issued.edu email (alumni email addresses are not accepted).
3. SheerID will either verify automatically through student enrollment databases, ask you to sign in with your school SSO, or ask you to upload proof of enrollment (student ID/registration confirmation showing your name and current term).
4. Once verified, your ChatGPT account is upgraded to Plus automatically; cancel in your subscription settings before the free period ends to avoid being charged.

Note: only for current university students in the United States and Canada, one per account, not available to high school students.

desc_zh: Anthropic 面向高校及非营利科研机构学者免费提供 Claude Team 标准席位，含 Claude Science/Code/Cowork，Premium 席位仅$15/月（原价$100）。
desc_en: Anthropic offers verified PIs at universities and nonprofit research institutes free Claude Team Standard seats (Claude Science, Code, Cowork), with Premium seats at $15/mo (reg. $100).
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」，点击 Verify now。
2. 以课题组负责人（PI）身份填写机构信息和研究方向，审核约需5-7个工作日。
3. 通过后邀请团队成员加入，Standard席位免费，Premium席位$15/月，限时优惠12个月。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Verify now.
2. Fill in your institution's details and research area as a principal investigator (PI); review takes about 5-7 business days.
3. Once approved, invite team members to join: Standard seats are free, Premium seats are $15/month, limited-time offer for 12 months.

name_zh: 豆包开学季：免费领 3 个月专业版
name_en: Doubao Back-to-School: 3 Months Pro Free for Students
desc_zh: 字节跳动豆包面向在校大学生推出 2026 开学季福利：完成学生认证可免费领取 3 个月专业版订阅，另享 2.5 倍免费额度，专业版标准套餐学生价 38 元/月（原价 68 元）。
desc_en: ByteDance Doubao's 2026 back-to-school offer: verified college students get 3 months of Pro free, 2.5× free quota, and Pro Standard at ¥38/mo (was ¥68).
claim_zh:
1. 更新并打开豆包电脑版（活动主要在 PC 端参与，每账号限领一次）。
2. 进入「设置 → 豆包专业版订阅」，点击右上角「学生权益」；或在工作任务模式发送「我要领取学生优惠」。
3. 按提示绑定抖音账号，用学生证或学信网在线验证报告完成学生身份认证。
4. 认证通过后领取 3 个月专业版订阅；同时可享 2.5 倍免费额度，以及专业版标准套餐学生价 38 元/月。
5. 侧边栏「技能 · 连接器 · 工作伙伴」→「开学季」专区可体验新生报到、课程学习、汇报 PPT、秋招求职等学生技能。

注意：开学季期间有效，具体以官方页面为准。
claim_en:
1. Update and open Doubao Desktop (the activity is mainly on PC; each account can claim once).
2. Go to "Settings → Doubao Pro Subscription" and click "Student Benefits" in the upper right; or send "I want to claim the student discount" in Work Task mode.
3. Follow the prompts to link your Douyin account, and complete student identity verification with your student ID or CHSI online verification report.
4. After verification is approved, claim the 3-month Pro subscription; you can also get 2.5x free quota and the standard Pro plan student price of 38 CNY/month.
5. In the sidebar "Skills · Connectors · Work Partners" → "Back-to-School Season" section, you can try student skills such as freshman registration, course learning, presentation PPT, and fall recruitment job hunting.

Note: Valid during the back-to-school season; subject to the official page.

name_zh: Tavily 学生免费 4 个月 Project（4000 credits/月）
name_en: Tavily Student: 4 Months Project Plan Free
desc_zh: 学生可免费领取 4 个月 Tavily Project：每月 4000 API credits，适合课程、科研和黑客松。用学校邮箱或学生证向客服验证即可。
desc_en: Students get 4 months of Tavily Project free (4,000 API credits/month) for research, coursework, and hackathons. Verify with a school email or student ID.
claim_zh:
1. 注册 Tavily 账号：tavily.com
2. 用学校邮箱发信至 [email protected]，或向客服提供学生证，完成学生身份验证。
3. 通过后会收到优惠码。打开账号 Billing 页，在 Project Plan 点 Upgrade，填入优惠码即可开通。

说明：Project 含每月 4000 API credits，为期 4 个月。适用于课程、科研、黑客松等。详见本页的「前往官网领取」
claim_en:
1. Register a Tavily account: tavily.com
2. Email [email protected] from your school email, or provide your student ID to support to verify your student status.
3. After approval, you'll receive a discount code. Open your account's Billing page, click Upgrade on Project Plan, and enter the discount code to activate.

Note: Project includes 4000 API credits per month for 4 months. Suitable for courses, research, hackathons, etc. See the "Get it on the official site" button on this page

name_zh: YC AI Stack 学生福利
desc_zh: 参加 YC 高校活动后，可领取价值超过 $25,000 的学生免费额度：AWS、Azure 各 $10,000，OpenAI $1,000，Anthropic $500，以及多家 YC 公司的 AI 开发工具。资格自活动日起一年。
desc_en: After a YC university event, students can redeem over $25,000 in free credits: $10,000 AWS, $10,000 Azure, $1,000 OpenAI, $500 Anthropic, plus AI tools from YC companies. Access lasts one year from the qualifying event.
claim_zh:
1. 参加 YC 高校活动（官方写 Fall 2025 起）。
2. 活动后查收确认邮件。
3. 用报名时的 Hacker News 账号登录本页的「前往官网领取」，资格会自动识别。
4. 逐项兑换云与 AI 额度。权益从活动日起一年。问题可写 deals@ycombinator.com。
claim_en:
1. Attend a YC university event (officially listed as starting Fall 2025).
2. After the event, check for a confirmation email.
3. Log in at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page with the Hacker News account you used to sign up; eligibility is recognized automatically.
4. Redeem the cloud and AI credits one by one. Benefits last one year from the event date. Questions can be sent to deals@ycombinator.com.

desc_zh: 美国 K-12 教师和学区可免费使用 Claude 教师功能，包括备课技能和对接各州课程标准。默认不拿内容训练模型。
desc_en: US K-12 educators and districts get free access to Claude for Teachers, including teaching skills and state-standards curricula. Training on your content is off by default.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 以美国 K-12 教师身份申请；学区管理员可为全校开通，含权限和 SSO。
3. 仅面向美国 K-12，不是全球高校学生计划。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Apply as a US K-12 teacher; district administrators can enable it for the whole school, including permissions and SSO.
3. Only for US K-12, not the global higher education student program.

desc_zh: 合格非营利组织和 K-12 学校可买 Claude Team 优惠价。页面展示约 $8/人/月，低收入和中等收入国家约 $3/人/月，席位约 2–150。需 Goodstack 核验。
desc_en: Eligible nonprofits and K-12 schools can buy Claude Team at a nonprofit rate. The page shows about $8 per user per month, or about $3 in low- and middle-income countries, for roughly 2–150 seats. Verify with Goodstack.
claim_zh:
领取步骤

1.  打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2.  20 人以下的组织用 Goodstack 核验（约 2–3 分钟）；更大的组织联系销售。
3.  资格含美国 501(c)(3) 及国际同等组织、公立和私立 K-12，以及部分基层医疗机构。价格不含税，以结账页为准。
claim_en:
How to claim

1.  Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2.  Organizations with fewer than 20 people verify with Goodstack (about 2–3 minutes); larger organizations contact sales.
3.  Eligibility includes U.S. 501(c)(3) and international equivalent organizations, public and private K-12, and some community health centers. Prices exclude tax and are subject to the checkout page.

desc_zh: 合格非营利组织购买 ChatGPT Business 标准席位可享优惠：年付约 $8/人/月，月付约 $10/人/月。高级席位不打折。Enterprise 可联系销售，最高约 75% 折扣。
desc_en: Eligible nonprofits can get ChatGPT Business Standard seats at about $8 per user per month billed annually, or $10 monthly. Premium seats are excluded. Enterprise discounts of up to 75% go through sales.
claim_zh:
1. 按帮助中心表格用组织邮箱申请，由 Goodstack 核验。
2. 已有 Business 订阅的，通过后当前周期按比例折扣；新用户核验后在结账页只对标准席位打折。
3. API 目前没有非营利折扣。需要 BAA 要走 Enterprise 销售。
claim_en:
1. Apply with your organization email using the help center form; verified by Goodstack.
2. If you already have a Business subscription, after approval the current cycle is discounted on a prorated basis; for new users, after verification, only standard seats are discounted at checkout.
3. API currently has no nonprofit discount. If you need a BAA, go through Enterprise sales.

desc_zh: 用学校邮箱登录后，Scira Pro 结账价为 $9/月；普通邮箱为 $15/月。邮箱域名匹配即可，不需要优惠码。
desc_en: Sign in with a school email and Scira Pro is $9 a month at checkout, versus $15 otherwise. The discount applies when the verified email matches an allowed domain. No coupon code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 用学校邮箱注册或登录。
3. 结账页会显示 $9/月的 Pro 价。域名不在允许列表时仍是 $15/月。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Sign up or sign in with a school email.
3. The checkout page will show the $9/month Pro price. If the domain is not on the allowed list, it is still $15/month.

name_zh: Claude 高校免费版（已结束）
name_en: Claude Free Version for High Schools
desc_zh: 东北大学、伦敦政治经济学院、尚普兰学院等学校曾经向本校账号提供免费 Claude。该校内通道已结束，现在不能按旧入口领取。
desc_en: Schools such as Northeastern University, the London School of Economics and Political Science, and Champlain College previously offered free Claude access to their student accounts. This on-campus access has now ended, and it is no longer possible to obtain it through the old entry point.
claim_zh: 这个福利已经结束。不要再按旧教程注册或向同学索要入口。是否还有本校合作，以学校自己的通知为准。
claim_en: This benefit has ended. Do not follow the old registration instructions or ask classmates for access. For any ongoing partnerships with your school, please refer to official announcements from the school itself.

name_zh: Claude Pro 高校优惠（已结束）
desc_zh: 斯坦福、华盛顿大学、康奈尔和卡内基梅隆曾经提供 Claude Pro 约 $1/月。该限时校内优惠已结束。
desc_en: Stanford, University of Washington, Cornell, and Carnegie Mellon once offered Claude Pro for approximately $1/month. This limited-time university discount has ended.
claim_zh: 这个优惠已经结束，不会再按每月 $1 开通。现在的价格以 Claude 官网结算页为准。
claim_en: This discount has ended and will no longer be available at $1 per month. The current price is subject to the settlement page on the official Claude website.

name_zh: Claude API 学生体验金（已结束）
desc_zh: Anthropic 曾经向学生开发者提供 $50 API 体验金。该申请通道已结束。
desc_en: Anthropic previously offered student developers a $50 API trial credit. This application channel has now ended.
claim_zh: 这个体验金已经结束。不要再按旧表单申请 $50 额度。
claim_en: This trial credit has ended. Do not apply for the $50 credit using the old form anymore.

name_zh: You.com Pro 高校会员（已结束）
desc_zh: You.com 曾经向高校用户提供一年 Pro，可使用多个模型。该大学通道已结束。
desc_en: You.com previously offered a one-year Pro subscription to university users, allowing access to multiple models. This university program has now ended.
claim_zh: 这个一年 Pro 活动已经结束。是否还有新的教育价，以 You.com 当前页面为准。
claim_en: This one-year Pro promotion has ended. For any new educational pricing, please refer to the current You.com page.

name_zh: Grok SuperGrok 教育优惠（已结束）
desc_zh: 用教育账号登录曾经可以领取两个月 SuperGrok。该活动已结束。
desc_en: Previously, logging in with an education account allowed you to claim two months of SuperGrok. This promotion has ended.
claim_zh: 这个两个月免费活动已经结束，教育账号登录不会再自动开通 SuperGrok。
claim_en: This two-month free trial has ended. Logging in with an education account will no longer automatically activate SuperGrok.

desc_zh: Genymotion Desktop 是 Android 模拟器。教育版每年 $49，按每名学生、每台电脑计，学生、教师和学校都能申请，要学生证或教师证等有效证明。功能和独立开发者年付 $239.99 那档一样，含全部 Pro 组件。免费个人版功能更少，没有最新 Android。云端 SaaS 不走这个教育价。
desc_en: Genymotion Desktop is an Android emulator. The Education Edition costs $49 per year, per student and per computer. Students, teachers, and schools can apply, requiring valid proof such as a student ID or teacher ID. Its features are the same as the $239.99 annual plan for independent developers, including all Pro components. The free personal edition has fewer features and does not include the latest Android versions. The cloud-based SaaS version does not offer this educational pricing.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，在 Desktop 价格里选 Educational 申请。
2. 提交学生证或教师证等在读、任教证明，等审核。
3. 通过后再按年付费。不要选免费个人版，那个功能不全。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page, and select "Educational" when choosing a Desktop plan to apply.
2. Submit proof of enrollment or employment, such as a student ID or teacher ID, and wait for approval.
3. Pay the annual fee after approval. Do not choose the free personal edition, as it has limited features.

desc_zh: 501(c)(3) 或当地同等资格的非营利组织，可以免费使用 GitHub Team，或在 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上享受 75 折。这和 GitHub 学生开发者包不是同一项，学生不能拿个人账号申请。
desc_en: 501(c)(3) or locally equivalent qualified nonprofits can use GitHub Team for free, or enjoy a 25% discount on GitHub Enterprise Cloud. This is a separate program from the GitHub Student Developer Pack, and students cannot apply using their personal accounts.
claim_zh:
1. 准备慈善登记证明。点击本页的「前往官网领取」，按页面上的联系方式写信给 GitHub Social Impact。
2. 说明要免费 Team，还是 Enterprise Cloud 的 75 折。
3. 等审核邮件。通过后再在组织账号里升级，不要用个人学生包的入口。
claim_en:
1. Prepare proof of charitable registration. Click "Go to official website to claim" on this page and contact GitHub Social Impact using the contact information provided.
2. Specify whether you want free Team access or the 25% discount on Enterprise Cloud.
3. Wait for the approval email. After approval, upgrade within your organization's account—do not use the personal Student Developer Pack portal.

desc_zh: 501(c)(3) 及其对应的境外慈善组织、社会企业，可申请 Twilio 的短信、语音等产品折扣，并获得不会过期的免费用量，官方说足够发出数千条短信和通话。不要求签月度合约。超过 1200 万个组织可通过 Goodstack 快速审核。具体额度和折扣以批准信为准。
desc_en: 501(c)(3) organizations and their corresponding foreign charities and social enterprises can apply for discounts on Twilio's SMS, voice, and other products, as well as receive free usage that never expires—officially stated to be enough to send thousands of SMS messages and make calls. No monthly contract is required. Over 12 million organizations can undergo a fast-track review through Goodstack. Specific quotas and discounts are subject to the approval letter.
claim_zh:
1. 组织联系人点击本页的「前往官网领取」，按资格说明提交申请。
2. 一般 2 到 5 个工作日收到结果。通过后免费用量不会过期。
3. 先用免费额度做第一条短信或通话，再按折扣价扩大用量。
claim_en:
1. The organization's contact person should click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and submit an application according to the eligibility criteria.
2. Results are typically received within 2 to 5 business days. Once approved, the free usage will not expire.
3. First, use the free quota for your initial SMS or call, then expand your usage at the discounted rate.

desc_zh: 已在当地政府注册、状态正常的非营利组织，可免费获得一年 GitLab Ultimate，云端或自建都可以，最多 20 个席位。不含技术支持。每年名额先到先得，捐助额度用完就停止申请。政治或宗教导向的组织通常不能参加。和面向学校的 GitLab 教育计划不是同一项。
desc_en: Nonprofit organizations that are registered with their local government and in good standing can receive a free one-year GitLab Ultimate license, either in the cloud or self-hosted, for up to 20 seats. Technical support is not included. Annual spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis, and applications will close once the donation quota is reached. Organizations with political or religious affiliations are generally not eligible. This is separate from the GitLab Education program for schools.
claim_zh:
1. 确认组织已注册且状态正常。超过 20 个席位不要在页面申请，改发邮件到 nonprofits@gitlab.com。
2. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，由组织联系人提交。GoodStack 会核验。
3. 通过后按邮件领取许可。每年续期必须由当初在客户门户创建订阅的同一个人操作。
claim_en:
1. Confirm that your organization is registered and in good standing. If you have more than 20 seats, do not apply through this page; instead, email nonprofits@gitlab.com.
2. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page, and have the organization's contact person submit the application. GoodStack will verify it.
3. Once approved, receive your license via email. Annual renewals must be handled by the same person who originally created the subscription in the customer portal.
badges_zh: 免费 1 年 | 含教师

desc_zh: 学生和教师登录后填表，可以把 Amp Megawatt 从每月 $20 打成 $10。只打 Megawatt，Gigawatt 不参加。官方建议配合已有的 ChatGPT 或 X Premium+、SuperGrok 订阅使用，包含的 $10 用量只够额外试用。已订阅的人下个续费日才生效，不退已付的钱。
desc_en: Students and teachers can log in, fill out a form, and reduce the monthly cost of Amp Megawatt from $20 to $10. This discount applies only to Megawatt; Gigawatt is not included. The official recommendation is to use this with an existing ChatGPT, X Premium+, or SuperGrok subscription, as the included $10 credit is only sufficient for an additional trial period. For existing subscribers, the discount will take effect on the next renewal date, and no refunds will be issued for payments already made.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，登录 Amp。
2. 按页面表格提交学生或教师身份。通过后 Megawatt 显示为每月 $10。
3. 如果已经在付费，折扣从下次续费开始，不会退之前的费用。活动可以随时调整或停止。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in to Amp.
2. Submit your student or teacher status via the form on the page. Once approved, Megawatt will be displayed at $10 per month.
3. If you are already paying, the discount will apply starting from your next renewal; no refunds will be provided for previous payments. This promotion is subject to change or termination at any time.

name_en: DevCycle Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: GitHub 学生包提供 DevCycle Starter 一年免费，不限席位、功能开关和用量，用来做功能开关、灰度发布和 A/B 测试。平台已由 Dynatrace 接手，领取以学生包页面为准。
desc_en: The GitHub Student Pack offers one year of free DevCycle Starter, with no limits on seats, feature flags, or usage, for implementing feature flags, canary releases, and A/B testing. The platform has been taken over by Dynatrace; please refer to the Student Pack page for enrollment details.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生认证。
2. 在学生包页面找到 DevCycle，按页面提示用已认证的 GitHub 账号开通。
3. 本页的「前往官网领取」仍可查看；2026 年 1 月起服务由 Dynatrace 提供，入口有变化时以学生包为准。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at GitHub Education.
2. Find DevCycle on the Student Pack page and follow the instructions to activate it using your verified GitHub account.
3. The the "Get it on the official site" button on this page remains available; starting January 2026, the service will be provided by Dynatrace, so refer to the Student Pack page if the access point changes.

name_en: SQLGate Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: GitHub 学生开发者包可免费使用 SQLGate Standard 订阅的大部分功能一年，用来连接和管理多种 SQL 数据库。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack users can access most features of the SQLGate Standard subscription for free for one year to connect to and manage various SQL databases.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生认证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at GitHub Education.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and log in with your GitHub account.

name_en: testmail.app Education and Open Source Support
desc_zh: GitHub 学生包在读期间提供 Essential 方案（约 $9/月）：每月 1 万封测试邮件、完整 API、1 到 3 天保留和一个随机 namespace。教师、开源项目和非营利组织可写信申请教育或公益用途。
desc_en: The GitHub Student Pack provides the Essential plan (about $9/month) during your studies: 10,000 test emails per month, a full API, a retention period of 1 to 3 days, and a random namespace. Teachers, open-source projects, and non-profit organizations can apply for educational or charitable use by sending an email.
claim_zh:
1. 学生先完成 GitHub Education 认证，再从学生包里的 Testmail 入口开通 Essential。
2. 教师、开源维护者或非营利组织发邮件到 support@testmail.app，说明教育或公益用途。
claim_en:
1. Students should first complete the GitHub Education verification, then activate the Essential plan through the Testmail portal within the Student Pack.
2. Teachers, open-source maintainers, or non-profit organizations should email support@testmail.app, explaining their educational or charitable purpose.

name_zh: Lovable Pro 瑞典学生免费到年底
name_en: Lovable Pro Free for Swedish Students Until the End of the Year
desc_zh: 在瑞典的大学、学院或国民高等学校就读、年满 18 岁的学生，用学校邮箱可以免费使用 Lovable Pro，从 2026 年 9 月 1 日到 12 月 31 日，含每月 100 积分。每人限一个工作区，不能和其他 Lovable 优惠叠加，也不含另外购买的积分。2027 年 1 月 1 日起自动改为学生五折。已经绑定付款方式的会开始扣费，不想继续要提前取消；没有付款方式的不会扣费。
desc_en: Students aged 18 or older enrolled in a Swedish university, college, or national upper secondary school can use Lovable Pro for free with their school email address from September 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026, including 100 credits per month. Each person is limited to one workspace, and this offer cannot be combined with other Lovable discounts or additional purchased credits. Starting January 1, 2027, the offer will automatically switch to a 50% student discount. Users who have already linked a payment method will begin to be charged; if you no longer wish to continue, you must cancel in advance. Users without a linked payment method will not be charged.
claim_zh:
1. 打开活动页。还没有账号的，先用瑞典学校发放、目前仍可使用的邮箱注册。Lovable 账号邮箱必须是这个学校邮箱。
2. 在页面上验证并领取免费 Pro。2026 年 9 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日之间随时可以领。9 月 1 日之后领取的，从领取当天算到 12 月 31 日。
3. 工作区如果已经在付费的 Pro 1，已付的周期不退款。免费从当前付费周期结束时开始，最晚到 12 月 31 日。
4. 免费期结束后会自动套上学生五折。已绑定付款方式的，2027 年 1 月 1 日起按五折扣费，不想续费要在此之前取消。
claim_en:
1. Open the promotion page. If you don't have an account yet, first register using a school email address issued by a Swedish institution that is still valid. Your Lovable account must use this school email address.
2. Verify your email on the page and claim your free Pro subscription. You can claim it at any time between September 1 and December 31, 2026. If you claim it after September 1, the free period will start on the day of claiming and end on December 31.
3. If your workspace is already on the paid Pro 1 plan, the period you've already paid for will not be refunded. The free period will begin at the end of your current paid cycle, but no later than December 31.
4. After the free period ends, the 50% student discount will be automatically applied. For users who have linked a payment method, charges will be applied at a 50% discount starting January 1, 2027. If you do not want to renew, you must cancel before this date.

desc_zh: 个人可用学校邮箱写信并核对学生证，首次购买任意 MDB 套餐享 5 折。学校在官网发布 MDB 指定教程并通过审核后，学生还能用学校邮箱免费使用高级组件 12 个月，仅限教育用途。
desc_en: Individuals can apply by email with a school email address and verify their student ID to get 50% off their first purchase of any MDB plan. After the school publishes an MDB-designated tutorial on its official website and it passes review, students can also use advanced components free for 12 months with a school email address, for educational use only.
claim_zh:
要 5 折：用学校邮箱写信申请，按回复核对学生证。
要免费：请教师或图书馆按页面要求把教程发在学校域名上，并邮件通知 MDB，通过后用学校邮箱领取。
claim_en:
For 50% off: apply by email with your school email address, then verify your student ID according to the reply.
For free access: ask a teacher or the library to publish the tutorial on the school domain as required on the page, and email MDB to notify them; after approval, claim it with your school email address.

desc_zh: 正在学关系型或 NoSQL 数据库的学生，可以用真实大学邮箱免费申请 DBeaver Enterprise 或 CloudBeaver 学术许可。审核通过后许可发到邮箱，一般不超过 3 个工作日。
desc_en: Students studying relational or NoSQL databases can apply for a free DBeaver Enterprise or CloudBeaver academic license using their official university email address. Once approved, the license will be sent to your email, typically within 3 business days.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用大学邮箱填写申请，并写明在学的数据库课程或方向。
2. 等审核邮件。通过后按邮件里的许可安装，不要先买商业版。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page, fill out the application with your university email, and specify the database course or specialization you are currently studying.
2. Wait for the approval email. After approval, follow the instructions in the email to install the license. Do not purchase the commercial version beforehand.

desc_zh: Crowdin 给学校项目学术许可。邮箱域名必须是学校的。公开项目用 Open 许可，免费且不限人数；要限制访问的私有项目用 Private 许可。只能用于教学，不能用于商业项目。
desc_en: Crowdin offers academic licenses for school projects. The email domain must belong to the school. Public projects use the Open license, which is free and has no user limit; private projects requiring restricted access use the Private license. This license is only for educational purposes and cannot be used for commercial projects.
claim_zh:
1. 准备一个学校域名的邮箱。
2. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，说明项目是公开还是私有，然后提交学术许可申请。
claim_en:
1. Prepare an email address with a school domain.
2. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page, specify whether the project is public or private, and then submit your academic license application.

name_zh: Astah UML 学生免费许可
desc_zh: 有学术邮箱的学生可免费领取 Astah UML，仅限本人在自己的电脑上使用，不能装到教室公用电脑，教师不能使用这个学生许可。许可每年 8 月底到期，到期前重新提交表单即可续领。
desc_en: Students with an academic email can get Astah UML for free. It is for personal use on your own computer only; it cannot be installed on shared classroom computers, and teachers cannot use this student license. The license expires at the end of August each year; resubmit the form before it expires to renew.
claim_zh:
用学术邮箱提交页面上的申请表，不要再上传附件。
查收 support@astah.net 的邮件（主题含 Free Student License），没有的话看垃圾箱。
每年 8 月前重新提交一次。
claim_en:
Submit the application form on the page with your academic email; do not upload attachments.
Check for an email from support@astah.net (subject contains Free Student License); if you don't see it, check your spam folder.
Resubmit once before August each year.

desc_zh: FlutterFlow 是用可视化方式做 Flutter 应用的平台。学生和教师可以按教育方案申请优惠，具体档位以价格页为准。
desc_en: FlutterFlow is a platform for building Flutter apps visually. Students and teachers can apply for discounts under educational programs; specific tiers are subject to the pricing page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，查看标了学生或教育的方案。
2. 用学校邮箱注册，并按页面完成身份验证后再升级。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to view plans labeled for students or education.
2. Register with your school email, complete identity verification on the page, and then upgrade.

name_zh: Termius 学生免费 Pro 和 Team
name_en: Termius Free Pro and Team for Students
desc_zh: SSH 客户端。持有已激活 GitHub Student Developer Pack 的学生，可免费使用 Termius Pro 和 Team 的全部功能，包括在多台设备间同步，以及和同学共享主机与会话。GitHub 状态必须是 Activated，只显示 Approved 还不行。状态刚变更时，同步到 Termius 最多可能要等 72 小时。
desc_en: SSH client. Students with an activated GitHub Student Developer Pack can use all features of Termius Pro and Team for free, including synchronization across multiple devices and sharing hosts and sessions with classmates. Your GitHub status must be Activated; Approved alone is not sufficient. When the status has just changed, it may take up to 72 hours for it to sync with Termius.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 GitHub Student Developer Pack 面板，确认状态是 Activated，而不是刚通过审核的 Approved。
2. 打开 Termius 教育页，用同一个 GitHub 账号绑定。
3. 如果刚刚激活，等最多 72 小时再试。
claim_en:
1. Open the GitHub Student Developer Pack dashboard and confirm that your status is Activated, not just Approved after review.
2. Open the Termius education page and link it using the same GitHub account.
3. If you've just activated your account, wait up to 72 hours before trying again.

name_en: BrowserStack Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: GitHub 学生开发者包包含 BrowserStack 一年免费许可，含 Live 和 Automate Mobile，可在 3000 多种桌面浏览器以及 Android、iOS 真机上做交互测试和自动化测试，价值约 $2,388/年。
desc_en: The GitHub Student Developer Pack includes a one-year free license to BrowserStack, covering Live and Automate Mobile. This allows you to perform interactive and automated testing across over 3,000 desktop browsers and real Android and iOS devices, valued at approximately $2,388/year.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 [GitHub Education](https://education.github.com/pack) 学生认证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点击 Sign Up with GitHub。
3. 用已认证的 GitHub 账号授权登录，领取 Live 和 Automate Mobile 一年免费许可。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at [GitHub Education](https://education.github.com/pack).
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Sign Up with GitHub.
3. Use your verified GitHub account to authorize your login and claim your one-year free license to Live and Automate Mobile.

desc_zh: 年满 13 岁、正在攻读学位或文凭的学生，通过 GitHub Education 认证后，可以领取合作方的开发工具、云额度和域名。教师不能领这个包。认证大约每两年要重做一次，很多合作方优惠从你开通的那天起算，不能反复领。
desc_en: Students aged 13 and older who are currently pursuing a degree or diploma can receive developer tools, cloud credits, and domain names from partners after verifying their status through GitHub Education. Teachers are not eligible for this pack. Verification must be repeated approximately every two years. Many partner offers are valid from the date of enrollment and cannot be claimed multiple times.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用个人 GitHub 账号申请。有学校邮箱就先在账号里验证这个邮箱。
2. 学校不发邮箱，或域名认不出来时，上传带日期的学生证、课表、成绩单或在读证明。
3. 通过后再从学生包里逐个打开合作方。每一个都要单独领，不是认证完自动到账。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and apply using your personal GitHub account. If you have a school email address, verify it in your account first.
2. If your school does not provide an email address or the domain cannot be verified, upload a student ID with a date, a class schedule, a transcript, or proof of enrollment.
3. After verification, open each partner's offer individually from the Student Pack. Each offer must be claimed separately; they will not be automatically added after verification.

desc_zh: 认证院校的学生和教师可以免费使用 JetBrains 全套桌面 IDE，包括 IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate、PyCharm、WebStorm、GoLand、CLion 和 Rider。教育许可不能用于商业项目。在读期间每年续一次，毕业后两年内买个人订阅可享 6 折。
desc_en: Students and faculty at accredited institutions can use the full suite of JetBrains desktop IDEs for free, including IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, CLion, and Rider. Educational licenses cannot be used for commercial projects. The license is renewed annually during your studies, and you can get a 40% discount on a personal subscription within two years of graduation.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱、ISIC/ITIC，或已认证的 GitHub 学生包提交申请。
2. 点邮件里的验证链接。通过后登录 JetBrains 账号下载 IDE，并在 IDE 里登录激活。
3. 每年要重新提交在读或在职证明。AI Assistant 只有试用，试用结束后是 AI 免费档或另付费。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and submit your application using your school email, ISIC/ITIC, or a verified GitHub student package.
2. Click the verification link in the email. Once verified, log in to your JetBrains account to download the IDE and log in within the IDE to activate it.
3. You must resubmit proof of enrollment or employment each year. The AI Assistant is only available as a trial; after the trial ends, you can use the free AI tier or pay for an upgrade.

name_zh: Navicat 学生一年免费许可
name_en: Navicat Free One-Year License for Students
desc_zh: 在受认证的非营利高中、大学或社区学院就读，并持有有效学校邮箱的学生，可申请一年免费、不可转售的 Navicat Premium、Data Modeler、Monitor 非商业版和 Navicat Cloud Pro。培训机构和非认证学校不能申请。每人只能申请一次，只能用于学习，不能交给第三方使用或谋利。
desc_en: Students enrolled in an accredited non-profit high school, university, or community college and holding a valid school email address may apply for a free, non-transferable one-year license to Navicat Premium, Data Modeler, Monitor Non-Commercial Edition, and Navicat Cloud Pro. Training institutions and non-accredited schools are not eligible. Each person may apply only once, and the license may be used solely for educational purposes, not transferred to third parties or used for profit.
claim_zh:
1. 打开学生申请页，填写 NAPP 申请表，并使用学校邮箱。
2. 确认学校是受认证的非营利高中、大学或社区学院。
3. 审核通过后获得一年许可。同一人不能再次申请。
claim_en:
1. Open the student application page, fill out the NAPP application form, and use your school email address.
2. Confirm that your school is an accredited non-profit high school, university, or community college.
3. Upon approval, you will receive a one-year license. The same individual cannot apply again.

desc_zh: SQLPro Studio 是 macOS 和 iOS 上的数据库客户端，学生可以按教育价购买，用来连接和管理多种数据库。
desc_en: SQLPro Studio is a database client for macOS and iOS. Students can purchase it at an educational discount to connect to and manage multiple databases.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，查看当前学生价。
2. 用学校邮箱或学生证明下单。价格以结账页为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to check the current student price.
2. Place your order using your school email or student verification. The price is subject to the checkout page.

name_zh: Working Copy 学生免费 Pro
name_en: Working Copy Pro Free for Students
desc_zh: iPhone 和 iPad 上的全功能 Git 客户端。用 GitHub 学生开发者包账号登录即可免费解锁 Pro 功能（原价 $35.99），可以克隆、编辑、提交、推送和发起 Pull Request。
desc_en: Full-featured Git client for iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your GitHub Student Developer Pack account to unlock Pro features (normally $35.99) for free: clone, edit, commit, push and open pull requests.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Education 认证，获得 GitHub 学生开发者包
2. 在 App Store 安装或更新 Working Copy（iPhone / iPad）
3. 在设备上打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点击页面上的验证链接
4. 用学生 GitHub 账号登录，即可免费使用全部 Pro 功能
claim_en:
1. First get verified through GitHub Education to get the GitHub Student Developer Pack
2. Install or update Working Copy from the App Store (iPhone / iPad)
3. On your device, open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and tap the verification link on the page
4. Sign in with your student GitHub account to use all Pro features for free

desc_zh: Windsurf 是专为保持编程心流状态设计的 AI 代码编辑器。使用.edu 邮箱注册即可享受 Pro 订阅超过 5 折优惠，无需额外验证。
desc_en: Windsurf is an AI code editor built to keep you in flow state. Sign up with a .edu email to get over 50% off on a Pro subscription — no extra verification needed.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」
2. 点击「Sign up with school email」，使用.edu 邮箱注册账号
3. 注册成功后自动获得 Pro 订阅超 50% 折扣
4. 如学校不使用.edu 邮箱，可通过页面 FAQ 联系官方申请
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Click "Sign up with school email" and register an account with a .edu email
3. After successful registration, you automatically get over 50% off a Pro subscription
4. If your school does not use .edu email, contact the official team through the FAQ on the page to apply

desc_zh: OpenAI 面向美国和加拿大在读大学生提供 $100 Codex 积分。通过 SheerID 验证学生身份后，积分自动添加到 ChatGPT 账户，可直接在 Codex 中使用，无需单独创建账号。
desc_en: OpenAI offers $100 in Codex credits for verified university students in the United States and Canada. Complete student verification via SheerID and credits are automatically added to your ChatGPT account for use in Codex.
claim_zh:
1. 访问 [本页的](https://xn--8pvn55a0tz/)「前往官网领取」，点击「Claim now」
2. 使用或注册 ChatGPT 账号登录（无需学校邮箱关联）
3. 通过 SheerID 完成学生身份验证（提供姓名、院校、学生证等信息）
4. 验证成功后 $100 积分自动添加到 ChatGPT 账户
5. 前往 chatgpt.com/codex 即可使用，无需单独注册 Codex 账号

注意：仅限美国或加拿大在读大学生（居住地也须在美/加），每名学生限领一次。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click "Claim now"
2. Log in with or sign up for a ChatGPT account (no school email association required)
3. Complete student verification through SheerID (provide name, institution, student ID, etc.)
4. After successful verification, $100 in credits are automatically added to your ChatGPT account
5. Go to chatgpt.com/codex to use it; no separate Codex account registration required

Note: Only for current college students in the United States or Canada (residence must also be in the US/Canada). Limit one per student.

desc_zh: Kiro 是 AWS 推出的 AI 驱动代码编辑器，支持规格驱动开发与自主 Agent。通过大学学生认证后，可免费获得每月 1,000 积分，持续一年，无需信用卡。目前支持部分精选大学，使用大学邮箱注册后通过 SheerID 验证。
desc_en: Kiro is an AI-powered code editor by AWS featuring spec-driven development and autonomous agents. Verified university students get 1,000 credits per month free for one year — no credit card required. Sign up with your university email and verify via SheerID.
claim_zh:
1. 使用大学邮箱注册 AWS Builder ID（本页的「前往官网领取」）
2. 登录后进入账户使用页面，若学校在支持列表中会看到"You are eligible for Kiro Students"横幅
3. 点击 Verify 按钮，通过 SheerID 完成学生身份验证（需提供姓名、生日、大学信息）
4. 验证成功后立即获得每月 1,000 积分，有效期一年
5. 当前支持学校：ASU、Cal Poly、CMU、Georgia Tech、NYU、U of Toronto、U of Waterloo 等
claim_en:
1. Register for an AWS Builder ID with your university email (the "Get it on the official site" button on this page)
2. After logging in, go to the account usage page. If your school is on the supported list, you'll see a "You are eligible for Kiro Students" banner
3. Click the Verify button and complete student verification through SheerID (you'll need to provide your name, birthday, and university information)
4. After successful verification, you immediately get 1,000 credits per month for one year
5. Currently supported schools: ASU, Cal Poly, CMU, Georgia Tech, NYU, U of Toronto, U of Waterloo, etc.

name_en: Zed Pro for Students – One Year
desc_zh: Zed 是带 AI 的协作代码编辑器。大学生验证通过后，可免费使用 Zed Pro 一年，包含每月 $10 AI 额度，以及无限次编辑预测。
desc_en: Zed is a collaborative code editor with AI. After verification, university students can use Zed Pro for free for one year, including a monthly $10 AI credit and unlimited editing suggestions.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用大学邮箱登录 Zed。
2. 完成学生认证。通过后看账户里是否出现一年 Pro 和每月 $10 额度。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in to Zed with your university email.
2. Complete student verification. Once approved, check your account to see if the one-year Pro subscription and monthly $10 credit have been added.

desc_zh: 虚幻引擎对学生和教育免费。学生许可可以发布项目；如果总收入超过 100 万美元，才按虚幻引擎的版税规则支付。课程作业和个人作品一般碰不到这个门槛。
desc_en: Unreal Engine is free for students and educational institutions. The student license allows you to publish projects; royalties under Unreal Engine's terms apply only if total revenue exceeds $1 million. Course assignments and personal projects typically won't reach this threshold.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用 Epic Games 账号登录。
2. 选择学生或学校许可并完成验证，然后再安装引擎。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in with your Epic Games account.
2. Select the student or school license, complete verification, and then install the engine.

name_zh: Qt 教育许可 学生和教师免费 12 个月
name_en: Qt Education License: Free for Students and Teachers for 12 Months
desc_zh: 有高等教育机构邮箱的在读学生和教师，可免费领取 12 个月 Qt 教育许可，只用于学习，不能商用。可以两套都领：设计版包含 Qt Design Studio Enterprise，可从 Figma、Sketch、Adobe XD 导入界面；开发版包含 Qt Device Creation Professional，支持 Python、C++、JavaScript、HTML5 和 QML，可部署到树莓派以及部分 ST、NXP、瑞萨 MCU，并附带 Design Studio Professional。没有官方技术支持，可以看 Qt Academy 和论坛。做出的应用只能为了学习分享。到期后可以申请续期。
desc_en: Current students and teachers with an email address from a higher education institution can receive a free 12-month Qt Education License for learning purposes only, not for commercial use. Both editions are available: the Design Edition includes Qt Design Studio Enterprise, allowing you to import interfaces from Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD; the Development Edition includes Qt Device Creation Professional, supporting Python, C++, JavaScript, HTML5, and QML, with deployment capabilities to Raspberry Pi and select ST, NXP, and Renesas MCUs, along with Design Studio Professional. Official technical support is not provided, but resources such as Qt Academy and forums are available. Applications created must be shared solely for educational purposes. Renewal can be requested after the license expires.
claim_zh:
1. 打开申请页，用高等教育机构邮箱填表，并设置 Qt 账号密码。系统会自动核对邮箱是否属于已知院校。
2. 查收验证邮件并点击链接，垃圾箱也要看。
3. 按邮件说明安装。许可 12 个月，需要继续用时再申请续期。
claim_en:
1. Open the application page, fill out the form using your higher education institution's email address, and set up your Qt account and password. The system will automatically verify whether your email belongs to a recognized institution.
2. Check your inbox for the verification email and click the link. Also, check your spam folder.
3. Follow the instructions in the email to complete the installation. The license is valid for 12 months; you'll need to apply for renewal if you wish to continue using it.

name_zh: v0 指定院校学生免费一年 Premium
name_en: Free One-Year Premium for Students at Designated Institutions
desc_zh: Vercel 的 AI 应用生成工具。目前只对页面列出的在读院校开放。用该校学生邮箱完成验证后，可免费使用 v0 Premium 一年。名单里有斯坦福、哈佛、普林斯顿、加州大学伯克利分校、麻省理工、纽约大学、滑铁卢大学等，并会继续增加。学校不在名单里时可以加入等候名单，同校报名的人越多，越有机会被加进去。其他学生仍可使用 v0 免费版。
desc_en: Vercel's AI application generation tool. Currently available only to students at the institutions listed on the page. After verifying your identity with a student email from one of these schools, you can use v0 Premium for free for one year. The list includes Stanford, Harvard, Princeton, University of California, Berkeley, MIT, New York University, University of Waterloo, and more, with additional schools being added regularly. If your school isn't on the list, you can join the waitlist—the more students from your school who sign up, the higher the chance it will be added. Students from other schools can still use the free version of v0.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 [本页的](https://xn--8pvn55a0tz/)「前往官网领取」，查看自己的学校是否在 Active Schools 里。
2. 用该校学生邮箱注册或登录，按页面完成学生验证。
3. 验证通过后获得一年 v0 Premium。学校不在名单中就加入等候名单。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to check if your school is listed under Active Schools.
2. Register or log in using your student email from the eligible school and complete the student verification process as instructed on the page.
3. Once verified, you'll receive one year of v0 Premium. If your school isn't on the list, join the waitlist.

desc_zh: Tower 是 Mac 和 Windows 上的 Git 客户端。学生申请通过后可以使用 Tower Pro，用来管理仓库和解决冲突。
desc_en: Tower is a Git client for Mac and Windows. Students who successfully apply can use Tower Pro to manage repositories and resolve conflicts.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱提交学生申请。
2. 通过后按邮件里的许可证激活。到期日以邮件为准，不要把它当成永久免费。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and submit your student application using your school email.
2. After approval, activate your license using the instructions in the email. The expiration date is as stated in the email; do not assume it is permanently free.

desc_zh: Firecrawl 是 Y Combinator 支持的网页数据提取 API，专为开发者与 AI 应用构建。学生计划为持有有效.edu 或学术邮箱的在校学生免费提供 10,000 个 API 额度，覆盖完整功能：网页抓取（Scrape）、全站爬虫（Crawl）、站点地图（Map）、结构化内容提取（Extract），无限制、无需绑定信用卡，额度到账即用。可用于学术项目、科研、黑客马拉松及个人学习。需更多额度可发邮件至 help@firecrawl.com。
desc_en: Firecrawl is a Y Combinator-backed web data extraction API built for developers and AI applications. The student program offers 10,000 free API credits to verified students with a valid.edu or academic email — full access to scrape, crawl, map, and extract with zero restrictions, no credit card required. Credits are added instantly. Eligible use cases include academic projects, research, hackathons, and personal learning. Need more credits? Email help@firecrawl.com.
claim_zh: 1. 使用.edu 或学术邮箱注册 Firecrawl 账号（www.firecrawl.dev）。2. 登录后进入 Settings → Billing。3. 在优惠码输入框填入 STUDENTEDU，点击兑换。4. 10,000 个免费额度立即到账，无需信用卡。
claim_en:
1. Sign up for a Firecrawl account with a.edu or academic email (www.firecrawl.dev).
2. After logging in, go to Settings → Billing.
3. Enter STUDENTEDU in the promo code field and click redeem.
4. 10,000 free credits are added immediately, no credit card required.

name_zh: Replit 学生版 Core 会员
desc_zh: Replit 是浏览器端 AI 编程与部署平台，支持随时随地编写、运行和部署代码。使用.edu 教育邮箱认证后，可享受 Core 会员 5 折优惠，仅需 $10/月（原价 $20/月）。适合正在构建作品集、个人项目和创业项目的学生。会员权益包括：完整 AI 额度的 Replit Agent（AI 自动编程助手）、无限私有应用（Private Apps）、生产级应用部署（Deploy）、更快的工作空间（Workspace）性能。
desc_en: Replit is a browser-based AI coding and deployment platform for writing, running, and deploying code from anywhere. Verified students with a.edu email get 50% off the Core membership — just $10/month (regular $20/month). Ideal for students building portfolios, side projects, and startups. Benefits include: Replit Agent with full AI credits, unlimited private apps, production app deployment, and faster workspaces.
claim_zh: 1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」。2. 使用学校颁发的.edu 邮箱注册或登录 Replit 账号。3. 按页面提示完成学生身份验证。4. 验证通过后，Core 会员将以 $10/月（5折）价格提供，包含完整 AI Agent 额度、无限私有应用、生产部署与更快工作空间。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Register or sign in to Replit with your school-issued.edu email.
3. Follow the on-page instructions to complete student verification.
4. After verification, Core membership is available at $10/month (50% off), including full AI Agent quota, unlimited Private Apps, production deployment, and faster Workspace.

desc_zh: 认证高校学生（及教师）可享 Lovable Pro 五折，例如 100 credits 方案约 $12.50/月，最长 12 个月。用学校邮箱或学生证验证，仅限当前免费套餐用户。
desc_en: Verified students (and teachers) get 50% off Lovable Pro — e.g. the 100-credit plan about $12.50/mo — for up to 12 months. Verify with a school email or student ID. Free-plan accounts only.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校邮箱登录 Lovable（需仍是免费套餐）。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点 Verify Student Status，用学校邮箱或学生证核验。全球多数认证高校可用。
3. 通过后按学生价订阅。折扣最长 12 个月；取消后再订无法重新激活该折扣。

教师也可用学术邮箱领取学生价；若要给整班开通，可看 lovable.dev/partners/education。
claim_en:
1. Sign in to Lovable with your school email (you must still be on the free plan).
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, click Verify Student Status, and verify with your school email or student ID. Available at most accredited universities worldwide.
3. After approval, subscribe at the student price. The discount lasts up to 12 months; if you cancel and resubscribe, you cannot reactivate the discount.

Teachers can also get the student price with an academic email; to set it up for a whole class, see lovable.dev/partners/education.

name_zh: Unity 学生计划（免费 Unity Pro）
desc_zh: 年满 16 岁、在认证学校在读的学生可免费领取 Unity Student：最新 Unity Pro 编辑器、Odin Inspector/Validator 教育许可、Synty 资源包和 Unity Cloud。通过 SheerID 验证，许可一年，在读可续期。
desc_en: Students 16+ at an accredited school can get Unity Student free: the latest Unity Pro Editor, an Odin Inspector and Validator education license, a Synty asset bundle, and Unity Cloud. Verify with SheerID. The license lasts one year and can be renewed while enrolled.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，按学段选择 Post-Secondary 或 Secondary。
2. 注册或登录 Unity ID（不必用学校邮箱）。
3. 用 SheerID 提交学籍信息；多数即时通过，补充材料会发邮件。
4. 查收许可密钥，在 Unity Hub 激活学生许可。
计划一年有效，到期或到期前 60 天可续；仅绑定一个 Unity ID。课堂机房请走学校 Education Grant，不要用学生计划批量装机。
claim_en:
1. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and select Post-Secondary or Secondary based on your education level.
2. Register or sign in with a Unity ID (a school email is not required).
3. Submit your enrollment information through SheerID; most are approved instantly, and requests for additional materials are sent by email.
4. Receive your license key and activate the student license in Unity Hub.
The plan is valid for one year and can be renewed at expiration or up to 60 days before it expires; it is tied to only one Unity ID. For classroom labs, use the school's Education Grant; do not use the student plan for bulk installations.

desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 可免费使用 GitKraken 学生计划 6 个月（Desktop、GitLens、CLI 等）。之后仍是学生可按官方学生价续，约等于 Pro 的 2–3 折。
desc_en: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 6 months of the GitKraken Student plan free (Desktop, GitLens, CLI, and more). After that, enrolled students can keep the discounted student price — official copy says about 75–80% off Pro.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack 并完成学生验证。
2. 用 GitHub 注册 GitKraken，或把已有账号绑到 GitHub。
3. 在 Pack 仪表盘点 GitKraken，或打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取 6 个月。
4. 到期仍是学生可续学生价；GitHub 教育资格失效后优惠可能消失。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack and complete student verification.
2. Sign up for GitKraken with GitHub, or link your existing account to GitHub.
3. In the Pack dashboard, click GitKraken, or open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim 6 months.
4. When it expires, if you're still a student, you can renew at the student price; after your GitHub education eligibility expires, the discount may disappear.

desc_zh: 公立教育机构的学生和教职工可申请免费非商用 SmartGit 许可。需真实姓名，学校邮箱域名要在官方名单内，人工审核后邮件发密钥。
desc_en: Students and employees of public educational institutions can apply for a free non-commercial SmartGit license. Use your real name. The school email domain must be on their list. Keys are emailed after a manual review.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，选择学术用途。
2. 填写护照上的真实姓名和学校邮箱。域名需在官方 swot 名单内。
3. 确认许可不共享。人工审核通过后，密钥发到邮箱。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and select academic use.
2. Fill in your real name as on your passport and school email. The domain must be in the official swot list.
3. Confirm that the license will not be shared. After manual review, the key will be sent to your email.

desc_zh: 合格非营利学校可由全职教师或职员申请免费 GitLab Ultimate（不限席位，含每月 5 万计算分钟），用于教学和非商业科研。许可不直接发给学生。中国机构需联系极狐。
desc_en: Qualifying nonprofit schools can get free GitLab Ultimate (unlimited seats, 50,000 compute minutes a month) for teaching and non-commercial research. Only full-time faculty or staff can apply. Licenses are not issued to students. Institutions in China should contact JiHu.
claim_zh:
1. 由本校全职教师或职员用学校邮箱打开本页的「前往官网领取」join/ 申请。
2. 学校需受认可、以教学为主、能发学历且为非营利。通过 Proxi.id 核验。
3. 学生不能个人领取，请让老师申请，或使用 GitLab 免费版。
4. 中国机构官方不发此许可，联系极狐 ychen@gitlab.cn。许可一年，可按年续。
claim_en:
1. A full-time faculty member or staff member at the school applies by opening the "Get it on the official site" button on this pagejoin/ with a school email address.
2. The school must be accredited, primarily teaching-focused, able to award degrees, and nonprofit. Verification is done through Proxi.id.
3. Students cannot obtain it individually; ask a teacher to apply, or use GitLab Free.
4. The license is not officially issued to institutions in China; contact JiHu at ychen@gitlab.cn. The license lasts one year and can be renewed annually.

name_zh: Zyte Scrapy Cloud 学生单元
desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可永久免费使用 1 个 Scrapy Cloud 单元：不限成员、项目和抓取时长，数据保留 120 天。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 1 Scrapy Cloud unit free for as long as they qualify: unlimited team members, projects, and crawl time, with 120-day data retention.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生验证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，按 Pack 入口领取。
3. 权益为 1 个永久免费单元。问题可写 support@zyte.com。
claim_en:
1. First verify your student status through GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and claim it through the Pack entry.
3. The benefit is 1 permanently free unit. For questions, email support@zyte.com.

desc_zh: GitHub Education 学生可自动获得免费 Travis CI：1 个并发任务，可添加协作者。需遵守合理使用。
desc_en: If your GitHub account is in GitHub Education, Travis CI gives you a free account automatically: one concurrent job and as many collaborators as you need. Fair use applies.
claim_zh:
1. 确认 GitHub 账号已加入 GitHub Education。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用该 GitHub 账号登录即可自动开通。
3. 学生账户为 1 个并发任务。
claim_en:
1. Make sure your GitHub account is enrolled in GitHub Education.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and log in with that GitHub account to activate it automatically.
3. Student accounts have 1 concurrent job.

desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 验证的学生，可免费使用一年 Neve Agency（官方写价值 $259），含不限站点、更新和支持。
desc_en: Students verified through the GitHub Student Developer Pack get one year of Neve Agency free (listed as a $259 value), including unlimited sites, updates, and support.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生验证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取。
3. 许可为一年 Agency，不限站点。
claim_en:
1. Complete GitHub Education student verification first.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim.
3. The license is one-year Agency, with unlimited sites.

desc_zh: 学生、教师和高校科研人员可免费使用一年 Sentry 教育账户。官方当前额度：不限成员、5 万错误、5GB 日志、500 万 spans、500 replays、1 个 cron、$20 Seer 点数/月。GitHub Student Pack 也可激活。
desc_en: Students, teachers, and university researchers can use a Sentry education account free for one year. The current offer lists unlimited members, 50K errors, 5GB logs, 5M spans, 500 replays, 1 cron monitor, and $20 in Seer credits per month. GitHub Student Developer Pack members can activate it too.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 持有 GitHub Student Developer Pack 时可按页面激活；教师和科研人员按教育资格申请。
3. 当前页面写明免费一年。额度以账户内实际配额为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. If you have the GitHub Student Developer Pack, activate it as directed on the page; teachers and researchers apply based on educational eligibility.
3. The current page states free for one year. Allowances are based on the actual quota in your account.

desc_zh: 用学术邮箱注册 Bitbucket，学生和教师可免费获得不限私有仓库，以及不限协作者。普通免费版协作者上限为 5 人。
desc_en: Sign up for Bitbucket with an academic email and students and teachers get free unlimited private repositories plus unlimited collaborators. The regular free plan caps collaborators at five.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校邮箱注册 Bitbucket。域名在认证院校名单内会自动变成学术许可。
2. 没有自动开通时，按页面申请并补充学校信息。
3. 在 Settings → Plan Details 里确认 Current Plan 为 Academic。
claim_en:
1. Register Bitbucket with a school email. If the domain is on the list of accredited institutions, it will automatically become an academic license.
2. If it is not automatically activated, apply on the page and provide school information.
3. In Settings → Plan Details, confirm that Current Plan is Academic.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可领 6 个月 Arduino Cloud Maker，以及认证考试约 5 折和部分开发板折扣（如 Micro 约 7 折、Due 约 5 折）。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members can claim 6 months of Arduino Cloud Maker, about 50% off Arduino Certification, and hardware discounts such as about 30% off Micro and 50% off Due.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取优惠码。
3. 软件为 6 个月 Cloud Maker。硬件折扣在 Arduino 商店结账时填写优惠码。
claim_en:
1. First get approved for the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim the discount code.
3. Software is 6 months of Cloud Maker. For hardware discounts, enter the discount code at checkout in the Arduino Store.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可领 Blockchair API 密钥：10 万次请求，有效期 1 年，覆盖多条区块链数据。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members can get a Blockchair API key with 100,000 requests, valid for 1 year, across multiple blockchains.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取密钥。
3. 额度为 10 万次请求、1 年。用完或到期后按普通方案计。
claim_en:
1. Join the GitHub Student Developer Pack first.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim your key.
3. The allowance is 100,000 requests for 1 year. After it runs out or expires, regular plan charges apply.

desc_zh: GitHub 学生可免费试用 DeepScan 6 个月，用于 JavaScript 代码质量检查，并和 GitHub 推送集成。每个用户限领一次。
desc_en: GitHub students get a free 6-month DeepScan trial for JavaScript code quality, integrated with GitHub pushes. One redemption per user.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点 Get the Student Offer。
3. 需用免费方案的团队领取，不能和入门试用叠加。失去 Pack 资格后会降回免费版。
claim_en:
1. Join the GitHub Student Developer Pack first.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Get the Student Offer.
3. Must be claimed by a team on the free plan; it cannot be combined with the Intro trial. After losing Pack eligibility, it reverts to the free version.

desc_zh: GitHub 学生可免费使用一年 Honeybadger Small：22.5 万错误额度、60 天保留、60 个可用性检查、不限用户和应用。官方写价值超过 $700。
desc_en: GitHub students get Honeybadger Small free for one year: a 225,000 error limit, 60-day retention, 60 uptime checks, and unlimited users and apps. Honeybadger lists it as over a $700 value.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取一年 Small 方案。
3. 问题可写 support@honeybadger.io。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim the one-year Small plan.
3. For questions, email support@honeybadger.io.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可在学籍有效期内免费使用 LocalStack 的 AWS 本地模拟器，并含每月 1,000 CI/CD 额度。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get LocalStack's AWS emulator free while they stay in the Pack, including 1,000 CI/CD credits a month.
claim_zh:
1. 确认 GitHub Education 权益有效。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 关联并开通学生计划。
3. 若进了付费试用，到 Settings → Billing 再选 Student Plan。离开 Pack 后不再符合。
claim_en:
1. Confirm your GitHub Education benefits are active.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, connect with GitHub, and activate the student plan.
3. If you entered a paid trial, go to Settings → Billing and then select Student Plan. You are no longer eligible after leaving the Pack.

desc_zh: GitHub 学生可免费使用一年 TestMu AI（原 LambdaTest）Live 单并行会话，在 3000+ 浏览器环境里做手动测试、截图和响应式检查。
desc_en: GitHub students get one year of TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) Live with 1 parallel session: unlimited manual testing, screenshots, and responsive checks on 3000+ browser environments.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 注册领取。
3. 官方说明为 Live-1 并行会话、一年。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign up with GitHub to claim.
3. The official description is Live-1 parallel session, one year.

desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Education 验证的学生可免费使用 New Relic。学生账户含每月 500GB 和 3 个完整平台用户。GitHub 教育页写价值约 $300/月。
desc_en: Students verified through GitHub Education get New Relic free. The student account includes 500 GB a month and three full platform users. GitHub Education lists it at about a $300 monthly value.
claim_zh:

name_zh: AWS Builder Center 学生奖励计划
desc_zh: AWS 学生福利计划：验证学生身份并完善资料，立即解锁12个月Skill Builder高级会员（价值$449），活跃赢徽章还可再得$30积分和$100认证考试券。
desc_en: Verify your student status to unlock 12 months of AWS Skill Builder Premium free ($449 value), plus earn AWS credits and a $100 certification exam voucher through activity badges.
claim_zh:
1. 访问 builder.aws.com 并登录/注册 AWS Builder Center 账号（可用现有 AWS 账号登录）。
2. 在个人资料页找到 Student Status（学生状态）入口，点击进行 SheerID 学生身份验证，通常几分钟内完成（需年满 18 岁、在认可高校在读）。
3. 验证通过后，完善 Builder Center 个人资料：上传头像并填写 About 简介，完成后立即解锁 12 个月 AWS Skill Builder 高级会员（价值 $449）。
4. 在 Builder Center 保持活跃赢取徽章：发表文章、评论、参与 Wishlist 等操作可累积徽章。
5. 达到 7 个徽章解锁 $10 云积分；14 个徽章再得 $20；21 个徽章兑换 $100 的 AWS Foundational 认证考试代金券。
注意：该计划为 2026 返校季限时推出，具体权益与有效期以官方页面为准。
claim_en:
1. Visit builder.aws.com and log in/register for an AWS Builder Center account (you can use your existing AWS account to log in).
2. On your profile page, find the Student Status entry, click to verify your student status via SheerID, which usually takes a few minutes (you must be at least 18 years old and enrolled at an accredited college or university).
3. After verification, complete your Builder Center profile: upload a profile picture and fill in the About section. Once done, you will immediately unlock 12 months of AWS Skill Builder Premium membership (worth $449).
4. Stay active in Builder Center to earn badges: publishing articles, commenting, participating in Wishlist, and other activities can accumulate badges.
5. Reach 7 badges to unlock $10 in cloud credits; 14 badges to get another $20; 21 badges to redeem a $100 AWS Foundational certification exam voucher.
Note: This program is a limited-time offer for the 2026 back-to-school season. Specific benefits and expiration dates are subject to the official page.

2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录后点 Request your access code。
3. 把 Atlas 优惠码加到所选 Organization（每码只能用一次）。未使用约 90 天过期，建议要兑换时再生成。
4. 兑换 Atlas 额度通常需绑定信用卡或 PayPal；额度按用量扣。完成学习路径后可领免费认证券。
claim_en:
1. First activate the GitHub Student Developer Pack (enrolled in a degree program, verifiable student status, have a GitHub account, and be at least 13 years old).
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, sign in with GitHub, and click Request your access code.
3. Add the Atlas promo code to your chosen Organization (each code can only be used once). Unused codes expire after about 90 days, so it's recommended to generate it only when you're ready to redeem.
4. Redeeming Atlas credits usually requires linking a credit card or PayPal; credits are deducted based on usage. After completing the learning path, you can get a free certification voucher.

Focus areas include simulation and modeling, generative training, inference, and agents. Resources can include up to 30,000 hours of H100 time or several RTX PRO / DGX Spark units. Proposals must utilize NVIDIA's pre-trained models or software stack and be written according to the guidelines and template for the current call. Applications are open globally, with competitive selection; this is not a personal benefit for undergraduate students. Officially, new applications are currently not being accepted.
