desc_en: Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Tingwu university public welfare plan expands storage to 200 GB and includes 500 hours of transcription. This offer is exclusively for university users who meet the requirements on the page; no additional hours will be automatically provided after usage.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用阿里云或学校要求的账号登录。
2. 完成高校认证后再看存储和转写时长。500 小时是总额，不是每月 500 小时。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in with your Alibaba Cloud account or the account required by your university.
2. Complete university verification to view your storage and transcription time. The 500 hours is a total allowance, not 500 hours per month.

name_zh: Otter.ai 学生教师 Pro 折扣计划
desc_zh: Otter.ai 是 AI 驱动的实时语音转文字与会议笔记工具，可自动生成课堂、会议的文字摘要与回放。学生教师折扣计划为合格的在校学生、教职人员及全职员工提供 Pro 个人月付/年付计划的专属折扣。适用机构包括非营利教育机构、经认证的中小学与高等院校及学区。使用学校邮箱（.edu 等）注册后，在升级页面选择"Student & Teacher Discount"即可享受折扣价结算。注意：折扣仅限个人 Pro 计划，不含 Workspace 协作功能。
desc_en: Otter.ai is an AI-powered real-time speech-to-text and meeting notes tool that automatically generates transcripts, summaries, and playback for classes and meetings. The Student & Teacher discount program offers reduced pricing on the Pro individual monthly or annual plan for eligible students, faculty, and full-time staff at nonprofit educational institutions, accredited K-12 and higher education institutions, and school districts. Sign up with your school email (.edu), then select "Student & Teacher Discount" at the upgrade page. Note: Workspace features are not included; individual Pro plan only.
claim_zh: 1. 使用学校邮箱（如 xxx@university.edu）在 otter.ai 注册免费 Basic 账号。2. 登录后点击左上角头像 → "Upgrade plan"。3. 在方案栏下方点击"Student & Teacher Discount"链接。4. 按提示完成付款（仅支持信用卡），折扣将自动在结算时应用。如邮箱域名不含.edu，可联系 Otter 支持团队提交学校认证文件进行人工审核。注意：须先退出 Workspace 才能使用此折扣。
claim_en:
1. Use a school email (e.g., xxx@university.edu) to sign up for a free Basic account at otter.ai.
2. After logging in, click the avatar in the upper-left corner → "Upgrade plan".
3. Below the plan section, click the "Student & Teacher Discount" link.
4. Follow the prompts to complete payment (credit card only); the discount will be automatically applied at checkout. If the email domain does not include.edu, contact Otter support to submit school verification documents for manual review. Note: You must sign out of Workspace first to use this discount.

name_en: ElevenReader Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: 已验证的学生可以免费使用一年 ElevenReader（价值 $99），把教材、PDF、论文、讲义和网页转成自然语音，不限次数。有跟读高亮，适合 ADHD、阅读障碍或长时间听读，1000 多种音色，iOS、Android 和网页都能听。要年满 18 岁、在读、学校在官方名单里，ElevenLabs 账号邮箱必须和学校发的邮箱一致。一年到期会按常规年费自动续订，要提前在账号账单里取消。已经在付费的不退款，等当前周期结束后再领。学校不在名单里，页面上可以申请加入。
desc_en: Verified students can use ElevenReader for free for one year (worth $99), converting textbooks, PDFs, papers, lecture notes, and web pages into natural speech with no usage limits. Features include read-along highlighting, making it ideal for individuals with ADHD, dyslexia, or those who struggle with prolonged reading. With over 1,000 voice options, it's available on iOS, Android, and web. Users must be at least 18 years old, currently enrolled in a school listed on the official list, and their ElevenLabs account email must match their school-issued email. After the one-year period, the subscription will automatically renew at the standard annual rate; to avoid this, cancel it in advance within your account's billing settings. No refunds are provided for existing paid subscriptions—redeem the offer after the current billing cycle ends. If your school isn't on the list, you can apply to be added on the page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校发的邮箱注册或登录。账号邮箱必须和学校邮箱相同。
2. 完成学校邮箱验证。通过后解锁一年会员，上传 PDF、讲义或网页即可听。
3. 一年结束前如果不要续费，到账号的 Manage Billing 取消。已经在付费的，先取消现有订阅，等周期结束后再按同样步骤领取。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and register or log in using your school-issued email. Your account email must match your school email.
2. Complete the verification using your school email. Once verified, a one-year membership will be unlocked. You can then upload PDFs, lecture notes, or web pages to listen.
3. If you don't want to renew before the year ends, cancel the subscription in your account's Manage Billing section. If you're already paying, first cancel your current subscription, then follow the same steps to claim the offer after the current billing cycle ends.
badges_zh: 免费 1 年 | 含教师

name_zh: 夸克开学季：学生/教师认证领网盘+扫描王 VIP
name_en: Quark Back-to-School: Free Cloud Drive & Scan VIP for Students & Teachers
desc_zh: 夸克 2026 开学季活动：大学生、教师完成教育认证可各领 3 个月夸克网盘 VIP + 3 个月扫描王 VIP（至 9 月 30 日）。教师节（9/8–9/12）教师经「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序还可额外领扫描王年卡，最高合计 18 个月。
desc_en: Quark 2026 back-to-school: verified students and teachers get 3 months Quark Drive VIP + 3 months Scan VIP (until Sep 30). Teachers can claim an extra Scan VIP annual card via the Quark Education Alipay mini program on Sep 8–12 (up to 18 months total).
claim_zh:
1. 打开夸克 APP，进入个人中心或搜索「教育认证」，进入开学季活动页；也可访问活动链接或「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序。
2. 选择身份：大学生（学信网学籍核验）或教师（教师资格证生效核验）。
3. 完成认证后领取 3 个月夸克网盘 VIP + 3 个月夸克扫描王 VIP（活动至 9 月 30 日，每用户限领一次）。
4. 教师节专享（9 月 8 日–12 日）：教师通过「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序完成认证，可额外领取扫描王 VIP 年卡；叠加后最高约 18 个月会员。

注意：具体权益与截止时间以官方活动页为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the Quark app, go to the personal center or search for 'Education Verification' to enter the Back-to-School Season activity page; you can also visit the activity link or the 'Quark Education Program' Alipay Mini Program.
2. Choose identity: college student (CHSI student status verification) or teacher (teacher qualification certificate validity verification).
3. After completing verification, claim 3 months of Quark Cloud Drive VIP + 3 months of Quark Scan King VIP (activity until September 30, limited to one claim per user).
4. Teachers' Day exclusive (September 8–12): teachers who complete verification via the 'Quark Education Program' Alipay Mini Program can additionally claim a Quark Scan King VIP annual card; after stacking, up to about 18 months of membership.

Note: Specific benefits and deadlines are subject to the official activity page.

name_zh: Tella 教育计划（6 个月 Pro 免费）
name_en: Tella for Education (6 Months Pro Free)
desc_zh: 认证院校师生用学校邮箱申请，可免费用 6 个月 Tella Pro（无限录屏、AI 剪辑、106 种语言转写、最高 4K）。到期不自动扣费；之后仍符合资格可享 5 折。
desc_en: Students and educators at accredited schools can get 6 months of Tella Pro free (unlimited recording, AI editing, transcription in 106 languages, up to 4K). It does not auto-charge. Eligible users can keep 50% off afterward.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校邮箱注册 Tella。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，提交姓名、学校网站和学校邮箱。
3. 审核通常数天。通过后当前工作区获得 6 个月 Pro，每个工作区限一次，免费期不用绑卡，到期不自动续费。
4. 结束前 30 天可在账单里选 Pro 并绑卡，5 折从免费期结束后开始计费。每 12 个月需重新确认资格，符合条件即可一直享折扣。

院系多席位可写 sales+education@tella.com。
claim_en:
1. Sign up for Tella with your school email.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and submit your name, school website, and school email.
3. Review usually takes a few days. Once approved, the current workspace gets 6 months of Pro, limited to one per workspace. No card required during the free period, and it won't auto-renew at expiry.
4. In the 30 days before it ends, you can select Pro in billing and add a card; billing at 50% off starts after the free period ends. Eligibility must be reconfirmed every 12 months; as long as you qualify, you keep the discount.

For multiple seats for a department, email sales+education@tella.com.

desc_zh: 认证学生可申请 Raycast Pro 五折（不含更高档 AI 加购）。填写官方表单，审核通过后用优惠码开通。
desc_en: Verified students get 50% off Raycast Pro (not higher AI add-ons). Apply via the official form; redeem the promo code after approval.
claim_zh:
1. 打开申请表本页的「前往官网领取」（官网说明见 www.raycast.com/pricing）。
2. 填写学校、学生邮箱、在读信息；如需可附在读证明。
3. 审核通过后邮件会收到优惠码。在 Raycast 或官网升级 Pro 时填入即可。

注意：折扣只适用于 Pro，不含更高档 AI 加购。
claim_en:
1. Open the application form the "Get it on the official site" button on this page (official details at www.raycast.com/pricing).
2. Fill in your school, student email, and enrollment details; attach proof of enrollment if needed.
3. After approval, you'll receive a discount code by email. Enter it when upgrading to Pro in Raycast or on the website.

Note: The discount applies only to Pro and does not include higher-tier AI add-ons.

desc_zh: 有大学或教育机构邮箱可自动获 Screen Studio 四折优惠。没有机构邮箱可把学生证发到 team@screen.studio 领取折扣码。
desc_en: A university or institutional email unlocks 40% off Screen Studio automatically. No school email? Send a student ID to team@screen.studio for a discount code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，填写学校/机构邮箱（如.edu、.ac.jp）。
2. 验证通过后自动获得 40% 教育折扣。
3. 没有机构邮箱：把学生证等证明发到 team@screen.studio，对方会发折扣码。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and enter your school/institution email (such as.edu,.ac.jp).
2. After verification, you automatically get a 40% education discount.
3. No institutional email: send your student ID or other proof to team@screen.studio, and they will send you a discount code.

name_zh: LanguageTool Premium 学生/教师最高 8 折
name_en: LanguageTool Premium: up to 20% Off for Students
desc_zh: 学生、教师、教授符合条件可享 Premium 最高约 20% 教育折扣。语法、拼写、文体检查，支持 30 多种语言，可装 Word / Google Docs。
desc_en: Eligible students, teachers, and professors can get up to 20% off LanguageTool Premium. Grammar, spelling, and style checks in 30+ languages; Word and Google Docs add-ons.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」了解学生/学术写作场景。
2. 学生页本身不标折扣数字。官方帮助写明：学生、教师、教授符合条件可享 Premium 最高约 20% 教育折扣（help.languagetool.org/hc/en-us/articles/39254510973335-What-subscriptions-does-LanguageTool-offer）。
3. 去 Premium 订阅，结账可试 EDUCATION 优惠码：languagetool.org/premium?coupon=EDUCATION
4. 浏览器插件或 Word / Google Docs / LibreOffice 扩展登录同一账号即可。免费版只改基础拼写标点。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to learn about student/academic writing use cases.
2. The student page itself does not list discount figures. Official help states: eligible students, teachers, and professors can get up to about 20% off Premium with an education discount (help.languagetool.org/hc/en-us/articles/39254510973335-What-subscriptions-does-LanguageTool-offer).
3. Go to the Premium subscription, and at checkout you can try the EDUCATION coupon code: languagetool.org/premium?coupon=EDUCATION
4. Just sign in with the same account in the browser extension or the Word / Google Docs / LibreOffice add-in. The free version only corrects basic spelling and punctuation.

desc_zh: 师生可免费使用 Excalidraw 白板。用教育邮箱注册后，Excalidraw+ 有教育价（法文官方页写明约 $4/月或 $36/年），以结账页为准。
desc_en: Students and teachers can use the Excalidraw whiteboard for free. An educational email unlocks reduced Excalidraw+ pricing (the French official page lists about $4/month or $36/year). Confirm the amount at checkout.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 免费白板可直接使用。
3. 需要 Plus（云端收藏、语音、PDF/PPTX 导出等）时，用教育邮箱注册并继续到结账，或完成身份核验后再看教育价。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. The free whiteboard can be used directly.
3. If you need Plus (cloud favorites, voice, PDF/PPTX export, etc.), sign up with an education email and continue to checkout, or complete identity verification to see the education price.

desc_zh: 学生和教师购买 Xmind 可走教育价。教育页展示 Premium 约 $3.42/月（另有划线价），需提交在读或在职证明，以结算页为准。
desc_en: Students and educators can buy Xmind at the education price. The education page shows Premium at about $3.42/month. Proof of status is required; confirm the price at checkout.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」选择教育方案。
2. 提交学生证、在读证明、课表、教师工作证明或.edu 邮箱等材料。
3. 审核通过后再付款。提供虚假材料会被取消资格。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and choose an education plan.
2. Submit materials such as a student ID, proof of enrollment, class schedule, teacher employment proof, or .edu email.
3. Pay after approval. Submitting false materials will result in disqualification.

name_zh: Glasp Pro 学生年付 6 折
desc_zh: 用.edu 或.ac 结尾的大学邮箱完成验证后，Glasp Pro 年付可享 6 折。月付不参加，且为限时优惠。
desc_en: Verified university students with a.edu or.ac email get 40% off Glasp Pro yearly. Monthly plans are excluded. The offer is limited-time.
claim_zh:
1. 用.edu 或.ac 大学邮箱注册 Glasp，账号邮箱必须和验证邮箱一致。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点 Verify Status 完成学生验证。
3. 折扣只用于 Pro 年付。其他学校邮箱后缀目前不支持。
claim_en:
1. Register for Glasp with a.edu or.ac university email. The account email must match the verification email.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Verify Status to complete student verification.
3. The discount only applies to Pro annual. Other school email suffixes are currently not supported.

name_zh: RoleSharp 学生 Premium（6 个月）
desc_zh: 用学校邮箱验证后，可免费使用 6 个月 RoleSharp Student Premium：每月 2 份定制简历、求职信、面试准备和无水印 PDF。不需要银行卡，到期自动回到免费版。
desc_en: Verify a university email to get 6 months of RoleSharp Student Premium free: 2 tailored resumes a month, cover letters, interview prep, and watermark-free PDFs. No card. The account returns to Free when the term ends.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，填写学校邮箱（.edu、.edu.xx、.ac.xx；Gmail 等会被拒绝）。
2. 点邮件里的确认链接（24 小时内），Premium 立即生效 6 个月。
3. 每个学生邮箱只能领一次。到期不扣费。之后可选付费通行证，校友首单有一次 8 折。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and enter your school email (.edu,.edu.xx,.ac.xx; Gmail, etc. will be rejected).
2. Click the confirmation link in the email (within 24 hours); Premium takes effect immediately for 6 months.
3. Each student email can only be used once. No charge at expiry. After that, an optional paid pass is available; alumni get a one-time 20% off their first order.

desc_zh: 用学生邮箱申请后，MindMap AI 学生价可超过 7 折：Basic 由 $9.99 降至 $2.99/月，Pro 由 $14.99 降至 $4.49/月。折扣码约 48 小时内邮件发送。
desc_en: Students can get over 70% off MindMap AI: Basic drops from $9.99 to $2.99/month, Pro from $14.99 to $4.49/month. The code is emailed within about 48 hours of verification.
claim_zh:
1. 用学生邮箱在本页的「前往官网领取」注册。
2. 提交在读证明。没有.edu 时，官方接受其他认证院校邮箱。
3. 约 48 小时内查收折扣码并激活。在读期间可按月续，折扣不能转给他人。
claim_en:
1. Register at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page with a student email.
2. Submit proof of enrollment. If you do not have a.edu address, other verified school emails are officially accepted.
3. Check for the discount code within about 48 hours and activate it. You can renew monthly while enrolled; the discount cannot be transferred to others.

desc_zh: 学生和教师用学校邮箱注册后，多数情况会自动开通 PDF2Go 教育高级功能，只限非商用，在读或在职期间可免费续。
desc_en: Students and teachers who sign up with a school email usually get PDF2Go educational premium tools automatically. Use is non-commercial, and the license can be renewed for free while you study or teach.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱点 Get started。
2. 学校能自动识别时，教育高级功能会直接开通；否则联系官方。
3. 不得用于商业产品，也不得把许可分享给他人。
claim_en:
1. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Get started with your school email.
2. If your school can be recognized automatically, education premium features will be activated directly; otherwise, contact the official team.
3. Do not use it for commercial products, and do not share the license with others.

desc_zh: 高校写作项目（含电影学院）在读学生可免费使用 Highland 2 完整版一年。用学校邮箱和学生证申请，通过后在 Mac 版里解锁。
desc_en: Students in university writing programs, including film schools, can use the full Highland 2 free for one year. Apply with a school email and student ID, then unlock it in the Mac app.
claim_zh:
1. 在本页的「前往官网领取」提交姓名、.edu 邮箱、项目和学生证。
2. 审核邮件通过后，从 Mac App Store 下载 Highland 2。
3. 菜单里选 Upgrade to Pro，再用同一学校邮箱升级到学生版。一年后打印会带水印，除非付费升级。教师可写 support@quoteunquoteapps.com。
claim_en:
1. Submit your name, .edu email, program, and student ID at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. After approval by email, download Highland 2 from the Mac App Store.
3. Select Upgrade to Pro from the menu, then upgrade to the student edition using the same school email. After one year, printouts will have a watermark unless you pay for an upgrade. Teachers can email support@quoteunquoteapps.com.

desc_zh: Loom 的教育页介绍用录屏做讲解、作业说明和答疑。该页没有单独的免费教育许可或学生折扣。
desc_en: Loom's education page shows how to use screen recordings for lessons, assignments, and answers. It does not list a separate free education license or student discount.
claim_zh: 打开本页的「前往官网领取」了解教学用法。页面未提供师生免费方案，账户类型以 Loom 定价页为准。
claim_en: Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to learn about teaching uses. The page does not provide a free plan for teachers and students; refer to Loom's pricing page for account types.

desc_zh: 高校全日制学生可申请 Linear Basic 或 Business 一年全免，用于学生项目和社团。教职工约 75% 折扣。高中、营利性和纯在线院校不符合。
desc_en: Full-time college students can get Linear Basic or Business free for one year for student-led programs and clubs. University staff can get about 75% off. High schools, for-profit schools, and online-only schools are excluded.
claim_zh:
1. 用.edu 邮箱写 support@linear.app，附上工作区名称。
2. 学生需全日制在读证明（官方不接受单独学生证）；教职工需在职证明和学校认证证明。
3. 不能用于商业。非营利另有 75% 折扣，同样写信申请。
claim_en:
1. Write to support@linear.app from your.edu email, including your workspace name.
2. Students need proof of full-time enrollment (an official student ID alone is not accepted); faculty and staff need proof of employment and school verification.
3. Cannot be used for commercial purposes. Nonprofits have a separate 75% discount; apply by email as well.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可免费使用 RoundPie Lite：最多 3 个任务工具集成、近 6 个月记录。在 Pack 有效期内可续。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get RoundPie Lite free: up to 3 task-tool integrations and 6 months of activity history. It can be extended while the Pack membership stays active.
claim_zh:
1. 注册 RoundPie，打开个人资料页。
2. 连接 GitHub Student Developer Pack，升级到免费 Lite。每个 GitHub 学生账号只能升级一个 RoundPie 账号。
3. 不含团队管理和 Jira、Asana 等企业集成。Ultimate 学生另有 5 折，需联系官方。
claim_en:
1. Sign up for RoundPie and open your profile page.
2. Connect GitHub Student Developer Pack and upgrade to free Lite. Each GitHub student account can only upgrade one RoundPie account.
3. Does not include team management and enterprise integrations such as Jira and Asana. Ultimate students get an additional 50% off; contact the official.

name_zh: 网易有道词典学生认证（已结束）
